Deafblind people who are skilled in Finger Braille can understand the speech conversation and express various emotions. Because there is such a small number of non-disabled people who are skilled in Finger Braille, deafblind people communicate only through an interpreter. The objective of this study is development of a Finger Braille support device which assists not only verbal communication but also non-verbal (emotional) communication between deafblind people and non-disabled people who are not skilled in Finger Braille. In this paper, we evaluated the emotional expression by non-disabled people by applying the emotion feature vectors and their distances. The results showed that the range of the distances of intra subjects represented the degree of the emotional expression by the subject; the distances of inter subjects represented the similarities of the emotional expression by the two subjects.

articleTitle: A method for web documents clustering based on dynamic concept
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Conceptual clustering can be used to solve the lack of domain knowledge or incompleteness. According to the organizational structure and characteristics of web documents subject information, and based on the conceptual clustering techniques, the paper proposes and implements the dynamic concept clustering algorithm and merge algorithm for web documents clustering, and proves the superiority of these algorithms by analyzing the efficiency and clustering accuracy.

articleTitle: The design of a 2.45 GHz low-power low-noise amplifier
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: In this paper, a low noise amplifier (LNA) with a newly architecture of fully integrated common-source is designed based on TSMC 0.35 μm CMOS process, which worked at the frequency of 2.45 GHz. For input matching, LC parallel network is used instead of the traditional large inductor, and a capacitor is paralleled on the gate. Simulation results with LNA design shows that the newly architecture can conducive to the input matching and can reduce noise and power.

articleTitle: The application of geographic information system in HBV genotype
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: The geographic information system is an application engineering technology of the management and the analysis spatial data, with gathering, management, processing, and analysis of the spatial data. The geographic information system can be use to solve the complex plan and the management question. Molecular biology rapidly expands causes thorough understanding about HBV. But the research concerning the geographic distribution of HBV genotypes is limited. This article attempts to discuss application of the geographic information system technology in HBV genotype. The paper reflects the Chinese HBV genotype geographic distribution situation intuitively Based on geographic information system's data space analysis technique, and provides one kind of research idea and the technical program for the geography epidemiology research.

articleTitle: Hybrid particle swarm optimization algorithm for fixed-outline floorplanning
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) has proved to be an effective global optimization in recent years. A hybrid particle swarm optimization algorithm combined with Extremal Optimization (HPSO-EO) was proposed for fixed-outline floorplanning in this paper. A string structure and several novel updating operations for HPSO-EO are adopted respectively, according to the floorplan problem. We have carried the experiments employed the MCNC benchmarks to demonstrate the feasibility of HPSO-EO. Simulation results are shown to be effective.

articleTitle: GIS-based soil erosion-prone evaluation of highway domain
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: In order to predict the macro trend of soil and water loss within highway domain, the problem of soil erosion is studied. Used the pressure-state-response model and expert advice method, four factors, such as slope, slope length, vegetation coverage, rainfall were selected. The indexes were treated with dimension method, calculated the weight of evaluation indexes on the basis of entropy theory. Then, set up the soil and water loss-prone evaluation model of highway domain. Based on GIS and RS, analyzed the status of soil and water loss of highway domain in Qinghai Province. Used MATLAB tools, calculated the entropy of each index's value and the entropy weight, and established the thematic map, finished the quantitative analysis of soil and water loss-prone evaluation.

articleTitle: A universal neuronal classification and naming scheme based on the neuronal morphology
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Neuronal morphology, which is closely related to neuronal characteristics and functions, is complex and diversified, and it has gradually attracted more and more neuroscientists to study on it. As the neuronal classification is a basic point in neuronal study but no existing universal methods take neuronal morphology into consideration, this paper dedicates to fill this blank. Firstly, this paper used Principal Component Analysis (PCA) method to select five key features from twenty neuronal morphologic features. With these key features, this paper leveraged hierarchical clustering to cluster sixty neurons randomly selected from the NeuroMorpho.Org website. As a result, these neurons were divided into four categories. Finally, we devised a new naming scheme by the range of key features' values. Experiments indicated that this classification can effectively distinguish neurons by morphology. At last, this paper discussed and analyzed the anomaly that occurs after a large number of classification experiments.

articleTitle: Comprehension oriented software fault location
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Software errors can potentially lead to disastrous consequences. Unfortunately, debugging software errors can be difficult and time-consuming. A comprehension oriented software fault location approach (COFL) is proposed in this paper to provide automated assistance in bug location. It not only locates program predicates predicting bugs, but also provides high efficiency demand-driven data flow and control flow analysis to help developers understand the causes and contexts of bugs.

articleTitle: Study on EM-side channel test for embedded system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Aiming at information leakage of embedded systems, electromagnetic side-channel test technology is researched. A communication system model including electromagnetism-side(EM-side) channel of Embedded systems was established and a EM-side test platform was built. Based on this test platform, Encryption key capture experiments of FPGA-based Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) algorithm chip were completed. The proposed algorithm in this paper improves the EM-side differential analysis method in time-domain effectively by solving the signal synchronization, the higher demand of SNR and increasing the sensitivity of analysis. Experiment results show that test platform and the EM-side test and analysis method in this paper are feasible and effective.

articleTitle: The application of Oracle Data Guard in the Logistics Distribution Management Platform
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Aiming at the Logistics Distribution Management Platform's disaster recovery, this paper brings forward a resolution basing on the Oracle Data Guard technology. By building a physical standby database, transferring the redo log which record the change of the primary database to the standby database, and applying the redo log in the standby database, it ensures the data consistence, and thus resolves the Logistics Distribution Management Platform's database's backup and disaster recovery. Basing on the resolution, this paper designs a Logistics Distribution Management Platform's database's disaster recovery subsystem, the disaster recover testing and the long time running proves the validity of the resolution.

articleTitle: Processing digital signal using power spectral density function analysis in Matlab toolkit
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: This paper elaborates on the use of Matlab toolkit for digital signal processing, and it takes the example of power spectral density function in Matlab toolkit. Introduction of the engine and the compiler in Matlab, and the way to call for toolkit functions by Matcom of MathTool company.

articleTitle: Research on H.264 intra prediction mode algorithm
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Intra-prediction algorithm is a new technology in H.264, but rate-distortion optimization algorithm increases complexity. This paper conveys a new algorithm of mode decision system, which combines and improves some mainline optimization technique. The experimental result shows that it can make the calculation complexity get a great decrease.

articleTitle: The application of integer MDCT in MP3 audio
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: A practicable implementation scheme of integer MDCT (IntMDCT) and inverse MDCT in MP3 audio coding is proposed in this paper. The computational complexity of this scheme is analyzed, and the comparison with the existing schemes has also been made. The scheme requires more computation compared with existing schemes because it takes the transform windows into account, which is essential in lossless MP3 coding.

articleTitle: Partial near-duplicate image identification with global geometric consistency of subset-of-features
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: The task of determining whether two images are near-duplicate or not becomes increasingly important in many applications, such as copyright infringement detection, sub- image retrieval and spam image filtering. Traditional methods for near-duplicate image identification (NDII) usually extract image local features firstly, and then quantize them as bag of words (BOW); the frequency histogram is finally taken as the representation of image for NDII. However, the mismatches between local features, the lower distinctiveness, polysemy and synonymy of visual words all degrade the accuracy of NDII, especially for partial NDII. Although some geometric verification procedures have been taken, these methods are still affected by the mismatches and ambiguity of visual words. In this paper, we propose a novel scheme for verifying the global geometric consistency of subset-of-features for improving the accuracy of BOW model. If there is a subset of matched pairs of local features obtained by BOW model, in which the ratios of scales and differences of orientations are consistent, we take these two images as near-duplicate images. The cardinality of the subset can also be used for measure the similarity of the two images. Experimental results show that the proposed method can improve the accuracy of NDII prominently, and it is also effective and robust for the retrieval of some typical partial near-duplicate images.

articleTitle: Hierarchical index system for crash-stop service failure detection
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Service Availability is an important method meeting adaptive and general requirements of service failure detection and largely affected by failure detection indexes. Therefore, how to select appropriate indicators of service failure detection is an important issue. However, only small number of indicators in the existing service availability mechanism can't accurately describe the complex situation of a distributed system, thus difficult to meet the QoS requirements of applications. After researching on existing service failure detection algorithms, applications' failures and network survivability, this paper proposes a hierarchical index system for crash-stop service failure detection that considers ability to provide services, network performance, and load brought by failure detection.

articleTitle: Business modeling of the Banking Loans System based on UML
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: The paper introduces the basic steps to create the UML use case model with the Banking Loans System as an example. On the basis of use case model, capture and analysis the system classes from the use case description by grammar analysis. Then through establishing the associations for any two classes creates the class diagram model of the Banking Loans System. It provides a reference model for the Banking Loans System to achieve.

articleTitle: Cryptanalysis of two identity-based signcryption schemes
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Encryption and signature schemes are fundamental cryptographic tools for providing privacy and authenticity. In the last few years, a new separate primitive — called signcryption — has emerged to model a process simultaneously achieving privacy and authenticity. In this paper, we analyze two signcryption schemes: Yu-Yang-Sun-Zhu's scheme (2007) and Li-Xin-Hu's scheme (2008). To Yu-Yang-Sun-Zhu's scheme (2007), we give two attack methods that correspond to the semantic security and existential unforgeability. To Li-Xin-Hu's scheme (2008), we show that the scheme can be broken by the attacker. Besides the receivers, the attacker can also decrypt any ciphertexts. The receiver can find the targeted master secret key.

articleTitle: Research of connector model based on Knowledge Reasoning and assembly technology
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Connector-based component assembly is an effective way to reuse components. Combing with the status of Component model and component assembly method based connector, this paper puts forward a model named KRC (Knowledge Reasoning Connector) which based on knowledge reasoning. This connector module using the virtual component modes to encapsulate internal controls in a component, with this mechanism can let the connector with Control, coordinate interaction between components in the active way. The method of KRC with Frame work 4.0 platform has been well applied to the application system GUBD(Gas Under balanced drilling), which Combined the field characteristics of the Under balanced drilling.

articleTitle: Region-based multi-spectral image segmentation using evolutionary strategies
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: One of the most important stages of image processing is image segmentation to extract different features. In this paper, we present a region-based algorithm for multi spectral image segmentation using evolutionary strategies (ESs). We use ES to find the center of regions of the image and then classify it using Euclidean or angular distances. We also use different indices to evaluate the fitness of the resulted centers of ES (chromosomes) and compare their results to choose the best.

articleTitle: The document summary method based on statements weight and genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: This paper introduces a document summary method based on statement weight and genetic algorithm. In essence the method is a file set based summary method. The method is simple and effective. It can meet the requirements for the web page text in search engine.

articleTitle: Research on adaptive restoration image fragile watermark algorithm
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Combining the image spatial domain local properties with human visual system, the authentication data is acquired by computing class membership degree of each image block properties, which is generated by applying k-means clustering technique to cluster all the image blocks. Then the recovery data is composed of the average intensity by truncating the two least significant bits(LSBs) of each pixel with in each block. Finally, the Logistic chaotic encrypted feature watermark comprising 2-bit authentication data and 6-bit recovery data of image block is embedded into the two LSBs of each Pixel within its corresponding mapping block. The algorithm not only achieves superior tamper detection and locates tiny tampered positions in images accurately, but also has good capability of recovery the tampered regions effectively.

articleTitle: Study on enterprise information security in the ERP conditions
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: With the wide application of ERP system in Chinese manufacturing enterprise, information security problem becomes more and more important. Based on the discussion of the information security and the information risk, this paper systematically analyzed information security problems in the ERP conditions and targeted to bring the corresponding countermeasures and Suggestions.

articleTitle: A remote monitoring system for full-color LED lighting based on Ethernet
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: A remote full-color LED lighting monitoring system, which uses Ethernet drivers and MCUs, is presented. The designs of the hardware and the software are given. The remote host computer sends out orders using UDP protocols, and then the MCUs receive them through the Ethernet drivers and transform them into the action orders to control the brightness of the LED lamps and monitor the current values of the LED drivers in order to ensure the normal operation of the LED drivers. The experiments results show that the system can effectively monitor the LED lighting system.

articleTitle: Research on stream data clustering based on swarm intelligence
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: This paper obtains the research and analysis on clustering algorithms for stream data mining. And swarm intelligence optimization algorithm is applied to stream data clustering analysis. Algorithms for the representative are particle swarm optimization and ant colony optimization has been studied. The generation of the algorithm to achieve and in the application of cluster analysis in a comparative analysis, and proposed the next step of a cluster analysis based on swarm intelligence in research work.

articleTitle: Reassembling 2DLDA for face recognition
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Two dimensional linear discriminant analysis(2DLDA) provides a solution to the small sample size(S3) problem presented to the classical LDA. However, it takes each column of the image matrix, which only contains partial information of the whole human face, as an input vector. In this paper, a novel reassembling 2DLDA (R2DLDA) algorithm is proposed for face recognition. The new reassembling 2D sample, each column of which is consisted of a sub-image of original face image, is introduced. Then 2DLDA is applied for face recognition. Experimental results on the ORL face database show that the proposed R2DLDA algorithm is feasible and has higher recognition rates than original 2DLDA and Alternate-2DLDA algorithms.

articleTitle: The optimizing model of the logistics warehousing distribution based on RFID technology
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Optimization of logistics warehousing distribution is of a significant practical meaning for improving the efficiency of logistics. RFID techniques can identify goods exactly, track the process of warehousing distribution and improve its efficiency. This paper establishes an optimized model of the logistics warehousing distribution based on RFID technology. By using this model, the efficiency of warehousing and resources utilization can be improved while the cost of logistics decreased, and thus improve the customer service.

articleTitle: Post-processing techniques for aortic computed tomography angiography
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Aortic diseases, such as acute intramural hematoma, acute aortic dissection and acute penetrating aortic ulcer are life-threatening disorders. Aortic computed tomography angiography can be helpful not only for pre-surgical planning but also for the follow-up evaluation. The volume-rendering technique (VR) and multiplanar reconstruction technique (MPR) are post-processing techniques within aortic CTA examination. The techniques of axial section and MPR can make accurate diagnosis, and the technique of VR is useful in pre-surgical plan.

articleTitle: Forecasting the mobile terminal technology with TFDEA method
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: With the accelerating pace of technological innovation, the uncertainty of technology development is also increasing, so it is important to estimate the trend of technology development through scientific and reasonable technology foresight. One of the recent foresight methods is TFDEA, which is based on data envelopment analysis and is theorectically an effective quantitative approach for technology forecasting. However, the application and research of TFDEA are relatively modest. In this paper, TFDEA is applied in assessing and forecasting the quantitative trends in the mobile terminal technology with its effectiveness tested.

articleTitle: The storage mode and query strategy for event ontology
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: For the difference between the traditional ontology and event ontology, this paper proposes a new event ontology storage mode and implements an event ontology system to manage the event ontology. The experiments show that the proposed mode has a higher query efficiency and lower data redundancy comparing to the XML storage mode. In addition, the new storage mode can preserve integrate semantic information of the event.

articleTitle: A stream sequential pattern mining model
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Stream is continuous, fast, dynamic and unlimited. Data stream cannot be stored in second storages for multiple scanning. In this paper, we propose a multiple level sequential pattern mining model, which is adapted to stream characteristic. It implements traditional mining algorithm over in-memory data to acquire accurate sequential patterns from data of ranges of stream. Besides, the model splits the memory into many levels to store sequential patterns under different minimum supports. In addition, this paper discusses the construction process of parameter optimization. Finally, a series of experiments is implemented to prove the effectiveness and efficiency of this model.

articleTitle: Automatic mechanism design for active service environment
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: In oriented service computing area, the applications of theory and technology of multi-agents can make it possible to change computing model from a centralized controlling type to a distributed cooperation form. In the meantime, we have to take some steps to constrain and lead global behaviors of multi-agents so as to ensure that an effective consultation alliance will bring out smoothly, for agent with self-interest feature in the traditional multi-agents theory. This paper presents an approach for proposing solutions to specific requirement based on Automated Mechanism Design(AMD) techniques. The main contribution is to describe how to built up the computational settings in mechanism designing process for active service environment, such as agency group, type sets, special outcomes for requirement, utility functions and an objective goal. After that, a simulation experiment is put forward to verify the rationality of mechanism designed in this paper as an ending.

articleTitle: Research on multi-classification algorithm for Semi-supervised Support Vector Data Description
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: This paper describes the classification and characteristics of single-classification support vector machine, and the advantage applied it to solve the multi-classification; then, combining the algorithm based on support vector data field description with semi-supervised learning idea, propose a semi-supervised support vector data field description multi-classification learning algorithm. This algorithm determine accept the label and refuse the label by defining the membership of non-target samples; through constructing more super ball on the target sample set and the labeled non-target sample set, realize the multi-classification algorithm based on support vector data field description.

articleTitle: ROI mask embedded SPIHT algorithm for image coding
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Region of interest (ROI) encoding is an important image encoding idea. This method solves the conflict between image quality and compression ratio, and it is appropriate to medical image encoding application. This paper presents a method of ROI encoding based on SPIHT. It adds ROI mask information instead of lifting the wavelet coefficients. The ROI is coded and transmitted in earlier stages with higher fidelity than the rest of the image, making the ROI takes precedence over other regions of the coding and transmission.

articleTitle: Research and implementation of remote sensing image processing method
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: C# is a modern, object-oriented programming language, which gradually being widely used because of its precise and simple features. This article uses C# programming language, for example, to gray-scale and linear transformation, achieving the desired results of remote sensing image processing. This method not only enhances the visual effect of the remote sensing image and improves the remote sensing image quality, but also makes programming more convenient and simple, easy to operate, greatly reducing the programming time.

articleTitle: Solved rectangle's NFP by polygon segmentation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Provide a utilising concave vertex to divided layout polygon for solving rectangle NFP problem. The convexity and concavity of polygon vertices was determined by their coordinates, then divide layout polygon into different feasible regions by concave vertex's edges and the unfeasible region will be deleted, offset the feasible region's vertex and gain the rectangle NFP. This method can be used for rectangle layout problem easily and directly. It is simple and efficient by analysis and some examples test and it has wide application in theory and practice.

articleTitle: Weighted concise association rules generation under weighted support framework
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Association rules tell us interesting relationships between different items in transaction database. But traditional association rule has two disadvantages. Firstly it assumes every two items have same significance in database, which is unreasonable in many real applications and usually leads to incorrect results. On the other hand, traditional association rule representation contains too much redundancy which makes it difficult to be mined and used. This paper addresses the problem of mining weighted concise association rules based on closed itemsets under weighted support significant framework, in which each item with different significance is assigned different weight. Through exploiting specific technique, the proposed algorithm can mine all weighted concise association rules while duplicate weighted item set search space is pruned. As illustrated in experiments, the proposed method leads to good results and achieves good performance.

articleTitle: Application of data mining in agricultural topic tracking
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: This paper combined characteristics of agricultural topic tracking, researches attributes reduction of Rough Set Theory. The experimental results show that the algorithm is verified to be more feasible and effective. Solve the key problems of agricultural topic tracking.

articleTitle: Intrusion detection based on ant colony algorithm of fuzzy clustering
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: An intrusion detection method based on ant colony fuzzy clustering was proposed, The algorithm uses ant colony algorithm is a strong ability to deal with local minima, it better than random selected cluster centers cause iterative process into a local optimal solution, dynamically determine the number and center of clusters.

articleTitle: Review of risk assessment approaches in the area of security system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Human society is faced with greater insecurity and challenges with the increasing unconventional emergencies in recent years. In order to response wisely and efficiently, we must first assess the risks of these unconventional emergencies. The risk assessment approaches in the area of security system are investigated in this article. After reviewing the evolution history of risk assessment approaches, we review the assessment approaches of threat, vulnerability, consequence these three factors of risk respectively.

articleTitle: Application of neural network to faults diagnosis of nonlinear circuits
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: This paper studies the Counter-propagation Networks (CPN) to faults diagnosis of the circuit. Using the CPN to build center of information fusion and fuse the data of multi-sensor in order to reduce the uncertainty of the faults diagnosis. Reset rules to overcome a shortage which the input vector limit too tight by the improvement of CPN algorithm of initial weight; Optimize operation steps of algorithm to improve the operating effects of algorithm; The results show that it improves membership value of the actual faults components and enhances the object's diagnosis analysis that faults diagnosis method of multi-sensor information fusion are based on the CPN and fuzzy mathematics. The experimental data shows that this method can accurately position the fault components of circuit, it performs advantage of fast speed training, high rate of diagnosis and wide suitability.

articleTitle: Research on Single-Exponent Multiple-Data attack on RSA cipher circuits
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Single-Exponent Multiple-Data attack against circuit implementation of RSA modular exponentiation algorithm are described. The attack algorithm requires an adversary to exponentiate many random messages with a known and a secret exponent. Experiments show that the attack algorithm is successful.

articleTitle: HCS: A fast and efficient algorithm to smooth hash collision
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: As a compact data structure with the capacity of supporting fast lookup, Hash table is widely used in many network applications. The accompanying memory accesses in- troduced by hash collision make hash table works at a slower speed than required. Under the case of serious collision, these applications have little time to proceed the following packet processing, and fail to respond to new arriving packets. In this paper, we introduce an efficient algorithm named HCS to limit the memory accessing cost in an acceptable range. At the core, it dynamically applies for a new hash table, and adopts different hash functions to rehash these serious collide connections. Furthermore, it will reclaim the applied hash table when necessary. Experimental results show that, comparing with existing algorithms, HCS can decrease the lookup times by 18% at least.

articleTitle: Synchronization in delayed discrete-time Complex networks
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: The synchronization problem of discrete-time complex networks with time-varying delays is investigated. Both time-varying delays in the network couplings and time-varying delays in the dynamical nodes are considered. The novel delay-dependent criteria in terms of linear matrix inequalities (LMI) are derived based on free-weighting matrices technique and appropriate Lyapunov functional proposed recently. An example is given to illustrate the effectiveness and advantage of the proposed synchronization criteria.

articleTitle: Formal verification on Distributed Spectrum Sensing Protocol
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Wireless networks will provide much more convenience for mobile users via heterogeneous wireless architectures and dynamic spectrum access techniques. However, wireless networks also impose challenges on developers due to unknowing global electromagnetic environment information in each node, as well as diverse QoS requirements of various applications. Therefore, both correctness and reliability of communication protocol become extremely difficult. In years, model checking has been advertised as a way to ensure the correctness of complex protocols. In this paper, we present a formal approach of formalizing and verifying a distributed wireless communication protocol used for cooperative spectrum sensing. Lots of well-defined properties are then verified for the protocol model. By using the model checker SPIN, we have discovered some vulnerabilities in the protocol, which can make some nodes trapped into either false liveness or zombie status.

articleTitle: Saturation throughput gain: A MAC layer performance indicator in terms of cooperations
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Cooperative networking is a highly promising communications paradigm that is expected to play an essential role in the next generation of wireless mobile networks. Many cooperation opportunities are found and decisions are made at MAC layer, where a performance index is needed as a reference to evaluate the effectiveness of cooperations. In this work, we serve this purpose by proposing a saturation throughput gain (STG) index. We present mathematically the STG of the MAC layer cooperative data relaying of direct spread spectrum ultra wide band systems. The result shows that STG can effectively evaluate the cooperation gain at MAC layer and varies significantly with different MAC layer fairness mechanisms.

articleTitle: The extension of long-running transactions compensation language-StAC
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: This paper investigates the StAC language (Structured Activity Compensation) which can be used to specify the orchestration of activities in long-running business transactions, based on the existing problems between compensation and termination in web services. First, we propose the extended StAC syntax, and then show two examples to illustrate the extended operators. Second, we present the operational semantics to ensure the compensation mechanism by labeled transition relations, making use of structural congruence relations, following a predicate of compensation updating.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable virtual test system on performance of circuit
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: This document presents and demonstrates the design of a reconfigurable system in the low-power circuit testing, based on the data acquisition platform which useing virtual instrument technology. The circuit performance automatic testing system has been developed which is reliable,stable and powerful. The use of virtual instrument technique enables test engineers to shorten the development cycle, and development efficiency has been greatly improved. Meanwhile, the design of reconfigurable strategy, makes test engineers very easy to test the circuit according to their own custom testing programs, and makes the system meets the different circuit performance testing, and reduces test engineer's duplication of work, significantly improves the efficiency of the test.

articleTitle: Research on application based on MIP table in IPv4/v6 mixed networks
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: IETF has specified Mobile IPv4 and Mobile IPv6 in RFC3344 and RFC3775 respectively, but not yet discussed Mobile IPv4/v6 in any published RFC. This paper proposes a scheme to solve one of Mobile IPv4/v6 problems which Home Agent (HA) and Correspondent Node(CN)are located in IPv4 network, while Mobile Node (MN) moves within IPv6 network. In the solution, a gateway called Mobile IPv4/v6 translation gateway (MIPv4/v6-TG) is introduced to bridge between IPv4 network and IPv6 network, which is made up of a traditional NAT-PT gateway and a Mobile IP application level gateway (MIP-ALG) built upon the NAT-PT gateway. MIP-ALG maintains a MIP table, a data structure, which is formed by entries. We use the MIP table to realize the communication between the IPv4 entities and the IPv6 entities. The creation, usage and update processes of MIP table are described in this paper. Through the experiment we find it can realize the basic communication in IPv4/v6 mixed network. The measurement of performance test proves the solution's efficiency. And it can work compatibly with RFC3344 and RFC3775.

articleTitle: Research on structure based on the adaptive a sort of the amending genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: The testing based on the genetic algorithm is a white-box testing method under the guidance of the demand analysis in software system. Traditional unit testing is mainly analyze the internal logical structure of products, but the Genetic algorithm structure testing is not only considering the internal logical structure, but also mainly analyze the association and the adaptive. The paper combined with the genetic algorithm of artificial intelligence to testing software, so as to explore the new methods and techniques to improve testing efficiency.

articleTitle: Topic tracking based on Naive bayes
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Text classification is the key technology for topic tracking, and bayesian algorithm is a simple and efficient text classification model. So we use bayesian text classification model as key technology for topic tracking and vector space model as topic pre-process model to develop a topic tracking system. The experimental results show that the system has good performance. Therefore, the Naive Bayes text classification model as key technology for topic tracking to deal with topic tracking problems is effective.

articleTitle: An ecological network teaching-learning environment
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Traditional teaching-learning has disadvantages such as insufficient teacher-student communication, insufficient personalized learning, serious plagiarism, and lacking of automatic grading of assignments. To solve these problems, an ecological network teaching and learning environment is proposed based on social constructivist teaching ideas. This platform consists of a teacher oriented ecological teaching platform and a student oriented online self-learning platform. We have explored and practiced various modes of teaching-learning based on this platform. Comparison with the traditional teaching-learning mode has showed that the ecological network environment can effectively improve the teaching and learning effects.

articleTitle: A method of color edge detection using mathematical morphology
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: It is difficult to effectively distinguish the similarity between colors in RGB color space, so color image processing is implemented in HSI space which reflects the features of human vision. An adaptive algorithm of color image edge detection based on multiple structure and multi-scale elements in HSI space is proposed. Firstly, morphological edge detection is executed by using different structure and different scale elements to hue, saturation and intensity. Then, according to the weight derived from information entropy, the color edge information is obtained by combining component's edge information. The experimental results show that proposed algorithm can make full use of the hue, saturation and intensity information to effectively eliminate the noise and adaptively extract the complete edge information.

articleTitle: Qualitative mapping model of humming melody extraction
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Some of the humming retrieval system and the qualitative mapping are introduced briefly. Combining with the music theory, a qualitative mapping model for extracting humming melody and its algorithm are given in this paper. The key points of the algorithm are the method to choose the criterion of the note segmentation dynamically and the dynamic measure to determine the pitch of a note. Experiments show that not only a better result of choosing flexibly and reasonably the criterion of the note segmentation can be determined, but also the note pitch can be extracted accurately. Eventually, the contour of humming melody can be achieved too

articleTitle: Research of Real-Time anomaly detection based on network traffic sampling measurement
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Real-Time anomaly detection is currently a hot topic in the area of network security research. In this paper, we firstly introduce the average length of data message as the measurement of abnormal behavior, and then advance a model of sampling measurement, in which the stratified sampling algorithm based on content trigger is utilized to select the bits in the IP packet identification field as the sampling and mask's length and contents. The comparison between statistic characters of total messages traffic and the samples in a large-scale network decides whether the samples are precise and efficient. Based on statistic characters of the samples and examination theory of hypothesis, real-time anomaly detection model is built. Lastly, average length of network data packets is defined to be the measurement of network behavior, and then we successfully realize the real time detection of distributed denial of service attack of network. Methods and ideas in this paper could provide some meaningful advice for other network security detection researches.

articleTitle: Based on the elastic mesh space distribution of resources solution modeler
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: This article in view of the grid resources distributed optimization problem established elastic mesh physical model and mathematical model, the optimal distribution grid resources problem change for calculating the elastic mesh space deformation process. The model and the method can depict between the grid space the base class node of the complex social interaction, and can describe base class as the situation changes of each node to strategy and autonomy dynamic behavior.

articleTitle: Design of five-axis CNC based on Linux
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: For complex parts of high speed, high precision machining demands, five -axis CNC system is studied, on the analysis of application of the embedded technology in CNC system, put forward a kind of new type of five-axis CNC system. The design utilizes an embedded multi-processor ideology to be S3C2410 processor as hardware core and motion control chips MCX314 as Secondary processor, the consistency problem of multi-processor communication is solved by a combination of bus and interrupt mechanism. Focus on the implementation of MCX314 driver and complete design of MCX314 driver in the Linux system. The address of two MCX314 motion control cards is completed by minor device number. Its practice indicated the method is correct and feasible,the program is stable and reliable.

articleTitle: Multiple concentrator 4over6 optimization in IPv6 access network
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: IPv6 transition becomes urgent problem restricting the evolution of Internet. A large number of mechanisms were proposed to solve transition problems. Especially, transition methods with IPv4 over IPv6 tunnel in IPv6 access network have been discussed intensely in IETF softwire working group recently. Many 4over6 mechanisms including stateful and stateless solutions have been proposed. This paper focuses on the 40ver6 scenario with multiple tunnel concentrators and proposes an optimization strategy which is based on two well-known stateful 4over6 techniques: dual-stack lite and public 4over6. We firstly bring up the requirements of multi-TC scenario, and then put forward a simple reference model. Then, a general optimization strategy of multi-TC scenario is proposed. Based on the strategy we give the implementation on both dual-stack lite and public 40ver6. The performance of both normal and optimization solution are then evaluated.

articleTitle: Manifold Inspired feature extraction for hyperspectral image
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Feature extraction is an indispensable preprocessing step for the large data, high redundancy hyperspectral remote sensing image (HSI). In this paper, a manifold inspired method, e.g., Laplacian Eigenmap (LE) is introduced for hyperspectral image dimensional reduction. In order to overcome the shortcoming of conventional manifold learning which could not deal with large data, linearization procedure for LE is proposed based on multiple linear regression analysis. Experiment on hyperspectral dataset demonstrates that the proposed manifold inspired feature extraction (MIFE) could preserve the local geometry of the samples in the original feature space. The low dimensional feature image could achieve a better classification accuracy rate.

articleTitle: Real time analysis of current transport protocols in high loss networks
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Internet real-time and reliable transmission is demanded in many applications. Existing transport protocols is hard to meet above requirements. For example, RTP is used in real-time applications, but it is not reliable. In high loss and delay networks, TCP is hard to provide real-time transmission. On the contrary, UDP is not reliable protocol. In this paper, the property of real-time is analysed which focused on TCP and UDP. Transmission delay and average transmission delay are employed to express the real-time. It is clear that low average transmission delay indicates better real-time. In our simulation, we focus on TCP about its real-time in high loss and delay networks. In addition, goodput is also important for users. High goodput and real-time transport protocol is desired for a number of applications.

articleTitle: A misbehavior resilient cipherblock trading protocol in BitTorrent-like networks
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: BitTorrent-like networks are prevailing on Internet, facilitating quick distribution of media files to large numbers of users via aggregating upload bandwidth at the user side. Their successes lie in initial optimistic blocks and active reciprocation on all established connections. However, some misbehaving peers may exploit or sabotage such premises, exerting free-riding, faking block exploit, collusion, and even denial-of-service attacks. This paper proposes a threshold-based verifiable cipherblock trading protocol in an attempt to mitigate aforementioned kinds of misbehavior simultaneously. Preliminary results about the best response of these misbehavior against the proposed protocol are presented. Also influences of protocol parameters (i.e. threshold and number of bits shifted circularly) are discussed in detail.

articleTitle: Distributed video coding with Multiple Reference Frame motion estimation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Side information construction in Wyner-Ziv video coding plays an important role which strongly influences the final quality of restructured images. In this paper we proposed an Improved Backward Multiple Reference Frame (IBMRF) motion estimation algorithm, which obtained motion vector with hierarchical block matching method, and then adopted backward multiple reference frame motion compensated interpolation to generate the side information. The simulation results showed that the proposed algorithm achieves a significant improvement both in PSNR and in visual effect.

articleTitle: Depth image improvement for 3D applications
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: This paper uses the area-based canny edge detector to keep the boundaries intact while applying the boundary-based depth image improvement technique to the flat areas. The proposed method will provide a better sense of depth by addressing image quality deterioration, which may take place in acquiring depth images in a limited environment, through post-or pre-treatment. We expect such improvement in depth images to be applied to various 3D applications, such as depth-based 3D body gesture recognition/interaction, depth-based image rendering (DBIR), 3D TV.

articleTitle: Modelling and simulation of underwater target's typical motion
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: In order to make the target's motion model more reasonably so as to improve detection probability of subsequent search action, according to different situations about whether target takes countermeasure or not, the target's motion can divide into three kinds, no countermeasure, countermeasure and uncertain information. Secondly, the forecast method of target's future position distribution based on three motions is explained respectively. Then, the motion model is proved validity by using simulation at last. This method will be worthful for the search tactics study to a certain extent.

articleTitle: Development of a polyclonal antibody based strip assay for detection of cadmium residue
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: A rapid immunochromatographic lateral flow test strip has been developed using a gold-conjugated polyclonal antibody (pAb) for the specific determination of Cadmium (Cd<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup>) residue in environmental water. For this purpose, the isothiocyanate method was employed to synthesize Cd<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup> artificial antigen and New Zealand white rabbits were immunized to produce anti-Cd<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup> pAb. Antigen and goat anti-rabbit IgG were respectively drawn on NC membrane as test line and control line. Gold-labeled antibody was added on a pad and put on one end of the membrane. The detection limit of this strip was measured to be 50 ng/mL. Except for high cross-reactivity (83%) toward Hg<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup>, no significant cross-reactivity was observed for other metal chelates tested. The results demonstrate that the developed method can be potentially used as a screening tool for the determination of Cd<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup> residues in a large amount of samples on site.

articleTitle: Analysis of path probability in VANET in a two-dimenstion scenario
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: A path from a source node to a destination node in Vehicular Ad hoc NETwork (VANET) often suffers broken due to the movement of nodes. In this paper, path probability in a two-dimension scenario is analyzed. With the assumption that vehicles are randomly distributed in a two-dimension grid map, and that all the nodes have the same transmission range. The analysis shows the following results. Number of turns and distance between the source and destination deteriorate path connectivity when they rise. However, path probability will benefit from the increment of transmission range and density of vehicles. The results are helpful to design better routing algorithms in VANET.

articleTitle: A Coarse-grained asynchronous data-driven design flow
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: As the synchronous circuit design is facing some limits, such as the power wall and the clock skew problem, the asynchronous circuit design is approaching a revival. This paper presents a coarse-grained data-driven design flow for asynchronous circuits, which aims at both performance and design efficiency. Based on a set of data-driven components, pipelined asynchronous circuits can be efficiently constructed. We optimize the circuits by combining components to form coarse-grained pipelines. Experimental results on an asynchronous pipelined 32-bit iterative multiplier show the efficiency of our design flow.

articleTitle: Flood control information metadata theory and its application
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: The resource information of flood control system has some characteristics which include dynamic, diversity, multi-source, randomness and magnanimity. How to fast and accurately obtain the right information from mass information has become a very big problem for users of flood control system. To solve the problem of resource information development and utilization in flood control system, based on the basic theory of metadata, this paper studies flood control information metadata. Firstly, the definition range of metadata is extended to resource object at any level, and to focus on the metadata of resource information at different level in FCDSS. Secondly, the structure of flood control information metadata management system is built, which is based on multilayer network structure. Finally, the method of making all-purpose menu and table is researched by using the above metadata theory, and the all-purpose inquiry module is designed, which can effectively integrate with FCDSS. The application of flood control information metadata can give core support for the exchange of flood control information, and provide theoretical basis and information support for integrated management of FCDSS.

articleTitle: The design and realization of Heilongjiang provincial flood control decision support system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Heilongjiang Province is one of the biggest inland provinces in China. There are few large control reservoirs to prevent great floods in its main rivers. So it faces more difficulties and increased loads in flood control. The flood control decision support system is a very important part of nonstructural measures in the practice of flood control. This paper analyzes the framework of Heilongjiang Provincial flood control decision support system, which integrates all flood control tasks, such as collection and transaction for information, flood forecast and flood control operation, decision making consultation, and so on, into a whole system. And two main subsystems are discussed and designed in details, i.e. the information service subsystem, decision making consultation subsystem. They focus on some content about the main functions, network architecture, key techniques and system realization. At present the system is running normally and has played an important role in flood control of Heilongjiang Province.

articleTitle: Based on the geostatistics of Land use change space date mining analysis
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: This paper use the geostatistics module of Arcgis9.3 software, By the Exploratory Spatial Data Analysis and Kriging of geostatistics method to do the deep mining of land uses change in west Jilin province. The mining results are graphically. The results of the study provide the objective reference of regional land and resource rationally develop and utilize.

articleTitle: Systems analysis and task analysis of free teaching blog
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: On basis of surveying China's current free teaching blog, system structure, management level, and management mode of free teaching blog are analyzed deeply through systems analysis and task analysis. Ways and means of improving free teaching blog are put forward.

articleTitle: Virtualization based grid resource management architecture
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: With the development and promotion of grid technology, the resource sharing has been greatly enhanced both in depth and width. But along with the continuous improvement for the people demanding the quality of service provided by the resource sharing, only sharing the using of resources could have no longer meet the needs of the people. The more stable and efficient sharing of grid resources has become the key problems which are urgent to be solved. The characteristics of grid resource have unstable factors, such as the two-division of grid resource, which is much more the key problem needed to be solved. Aimed at the characteristics of grid resources itself, this paper proposed the grid resource management architecture based on virtualization technology, the proposed architecture could be a very good solution for the instability problems brought by the two-division. On this basis it could improve the utilization rate of grid resources. The analysis proves that the proposed architecture is practical and feasible, and has the certain advanced nature.

articleTitle: Knowledge acquisition process based on data warehouse
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Aiming at problem of "knowledge is flood in the data ocean", the method of knowledge acquisition based on data warehouse is studied in this paper. The structure of data warehouse is introduced firstly. Then the study pays attention on the designing and building a data warehouse. Data warehouse offers a good platform for OLAP and Data Mining. Some meaningful information can be acquired from data warehouse by OLAP or Data Mining, which will provide valuable knowledge to support business process.

articleTitle: Network coding for cognitive radio systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: We consider a cognitive radio network where secondary users (SUs) employ network coding for data transmissions. SU transmission time is reduced due to network coding. And it increases spectrum availability to SUs. Our results show that compared to the existing approaches based on retransmission, SUs can achieve higher stable throughput, and the probability that SU has confliction with the primary user (PU) due to sudden appearance of a PU is smaller.

articleTitle: Trust vector-based sensitive information protecting scheme in automatic trust negotiation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: The existing sensitive information protecting schemes can not satisfy the actual security requirement of some applications. A trust vector based sensitive information protecting scheme is presented based on the existing schemes. One side in trust negotiation can selectively exposes the sensitive attributes to the other side in trust negotiation process based on personal security policy and the trust evaluation result of the other. The implementation process is given in concrete application instances and the scheme is analyzed.

articleTitle: Research of GIS components based on C++ / CLI and .NET assembly
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: The traditional COM component can not meet the requirement of cross-platform which plays a crucial role in the future GIS platform. But, the .NET assemblies, which have several advantages(such as high reusability, expansibility and portability), serve the needs of the development of cross-platform GIS software. First, this paper introduced the difference between .NET assemblies and traditional COM component, and then took the .NET assemblies based on C++/CLI as the key research object. Finally, taking GIS components of MapGIS K10 as an instance, a development method and key practices of GIS components based on C++/CLI and .NET assemblies was discussed.

articleTitle: The development and application of Cross-Platform Coal Mine Mobile Information System
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: With the increasing concern on the high-risk industries, the safety of coal mine has become the center of nationwide media attention. In another field, the application of Internet of Things (IoT) has infiltrated every aspect of daily life. In order to monitor real-time information underground, various applications based-on IoT emerge. However, each of the application must orient different intelligent terminals because of the heterogeneous platforms, which results in a problem of duplicated development. OpenPlug Studio, based on Flex, is an appropriate Cross-Platform solution to this problem. It realizes the conception of once development and multi-deployment.

articleTitle: TATree: A topology-aware multicast tree construction method for P2P Streaming
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: P2P Streaming is a popular alternative for video broadcasting. However, without the support for topology-aware overlay, P2P applications generate considerable inter-domain traffic, causing congestion in the backbone network. This paper proposes a topology-aware multicast tree construction method for P2P streaming. Through investigating the problem, we find out that there is a trade-off between inter-domain traffic and streaming delay. Three heuristic principles are proposed, taking the both factors into account. Based on these principles, TATree, a distributed algorithm for multicast tree construction is designed. TATree utilizes information provided by network coordinates systems and can be applied in super-peers to construct an optimized core tree. To evaluate the effectiveness, we set up two typical scenarios for simulation, one with the support from the underlay network and one without. From the simulation results, it can be observed that the method can reduce inter-domain traffic effectively at the cost of an acceptable increment in streaming delay.

articleTitle: Wavelet transform based noise reduction method for temperature data sequence in intelligent building
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: It is a kind of important basis for the maintenance of comfortable environment and the management of energy efficiency in intelligent building that the temperature and its variety at workspace in that building. Temperature in workspace can be sampled frequently and instantly with wireless sensor network. With some inherent electrical characteristics of sensors and sensor node as well as the complexity thermal feature of environment in intelligent building, there are noise in temperature data sampled by wireless sensor network. To acquire temperature in workspace accuracy, characteristic of temperature and its variety in intelligent building under ideal condition is analyzed and wavelet based noise reduction method for observation temperature data sequence is discussed in this paper. Wavelet function, wavelet transform scale and effective threshold method are confirmed. Experiments results show that wavelet transform based noise reduction method can reduce noise in observation temperature data sequence in intelligent building effectively.

articleTitle: Impact of global warming assessed from evolution of temperature relevance networks
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: This study assesses the impact of global warming in evolution process of temperature relevance networks. Temperature relevance networks are constructed from temperature curves with permutation tests to select statistically significant edges. After the networks were constructed, we employ sub-graph ration profile to study structure of the networks, come to the conclusion that mean temperature and relative sub-graph ratio for four-node complete graph changes in opposite directions and temperature relevance network will lose some features and become similar to corresponding randomized graph if the temperature keeps rising. Community structures are found in the networks, with motifs of the networks, we find that highly connected sub-graphs are more likely to appear in temperature relevance network than in randomized networks.

articleTitle: A finite queuing model with generalized modified Weibull testing effort for software reliability
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: This study incorporates a generalized modified Weibull (GMW) testing effort function (TEF) into failure detection process (FDP) and fault correction process (FCP). Although some researchers have been devoted to model these two processes, the influence of the amount of resources on lag of these two processes is not discussed. The amount of resources consumed can be depicted as testing effort function (TEF), and can largely influence failure detection speed and the time to correct a detected failure. Thus, in this paper, we will integrate a TEF into FDP and FCP. Further, we show that a GMW TEF can be expressed as a TEF curve, and present a finite server queuing (FSQ) model which permits a joint study of FDP and FCP two processes. An actual software failure data set is analyzed to illustrate the effectiveness of proposed model. Experimental results show that the proposed model has a fairly accurate predication capability.

articleTitle: Investigation of optical intensity fluctuation in the presence of satellite vibration for intersatellite optical communications
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: For intersatellite optical communications, vibration-induced pointing jitter severely influences the communication quality as a result of intensity fluctuation. In this paper the probability density function of optical intensity in the receiver plane is derived. Then the scintillation index is proposed to identify the intensity fluctuation. Finally the bit-error rate (BER) in the presence of satellite vibration is obtained as a function of the beam divergence angle and vibration variance. Qualitative analysis is given, and the numerical simulation is carried out for demonstration. It is suggested that for the desired BER of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-6</sup> and 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-9</sup> the ratio of the half divergence angle to the root mean square value of vibration should be design as 8.7012 and 10.7513 respectively. This work can benefit the intersatellite optical system design.

articleTitle: Priority-based resource allocation for OFDMA uplink with heterogeneous traffic
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Resource allocation for the uplink of OFDMA wireless networks is considered. In view of the distributed power constraints of the uplink, a low complexity resource allocation scheme for heterogeneous traffic is proposed. The scheme satisfies fixed-rate and variable-rate users via differentiated services. In the subcarrier allocation algorithm for fixed-rate users, a priority function based on user's channel state and power constraint is introduced to improve spectrum efficiency. Numerical results demonstrate that the proposed scheme can exploit multiuser diversity, and approach good tradeoffs between performance and complexity, efficiency and fairness.

articleTitle: Study on re-implement mechanism based on node-ability in Hadoop
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Face to massive web log data, single log analysis has been unable to meet people's pursuit of high efficiency, the traditional log analysis based on Hadoop has some drawbacks in resource utilization, etc. Therefore, based on traditional Hadoop task scheduler, a new tasks pre-scheduling mechanism based on node-ability is proposed, the size of the task block is determined according to the ability of each processing node. Thus, the conflicts between job execution time and system resource utilization is balanced, which can protect the jobs of the response time and effective enforcement mechanism to reduce the weight of the additional overhead and improve overall resource utilization.

articleTitle: A RSSI-weighted refinement method of IAPIT-3D
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: The location information is very essential to monitoring activities in wireless sensor networks. According to the low accuracy of IAPIT-3D (Improved Approximate Point in Tetrahedron) in beacon-sparse environment, we propose a RSSI-weighted refinement method. It reduces the occurrence probability of the “in-to-out error” by utilizing the improved GRID SCAN. Moreover, the RSSI-weighted method improves the accuracy and decreases the probability of “in-to-out error” simultaneously. The simulation reveals that this method enhances the accuracy relatively to IAPIT-3D and is robust to the low node density.

articleTitle: Research on band selection of MODIS data
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: MODIS belonged to the new generation of optical and thermal remote sensor that combines both images and spectrum is one of the most important sources for observing land surface change and analyzing the development of terrestrial biosphere. It is very important to determine the optimal band sets from its 36 bands according to specific application purpose for further management analysis and information extraction of multi-spectral dada. Based on the analysis of selection criteria, a subspace-division-based (SD) method was proposed after the comprehensive contrary of current modish methods. Then one swath MODIS data covered Beijing was disposed for supervised classification experiment to validate the suitability of this method. The validation demonstrated that the accuracy of land using cover classification using the 12 bands selected by SD method is 92.04% without other auxiliary data in medium-scale spatial resolution.

articleTitle: Research on business performance evaluation model of Power Distribution Network based on PTN
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: According to the characteristics of Power Distribution Network based on PTN, this paper presented its businesses performance indexes of three-layer structure system and established the comprehensive evaluation model, using the entropy method and the relative comparison method, which combined subjective and objective factors together and calculated the comprehensive evaluation value of the network business performance. By using OPNET simulation and examples to prove that the mathematical model in performance evaluation of the Power Distribution Network is feasible, and it will provide a basis for business performance evaluation after the large-scale network construction.

articleTitle: RFID security protocol trace attack and desynchronizing attack deep research
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) will become one of the most widely used devices in the near future. But the RFID security problem has hindered this technical promotion seriously. The extant RFID security protocols have the serious insufficiency and flaw to resistance trace attack and desynchronizing attack. This article proposed a security protocol that can against the intermittence time section position trace attack and desynchronizing attack, we have used mathematics term method with the Learning Parity with Noise(LPN) to prove the protocol's security.

Author Keywords: intermittence time section position trace attack

articleTitle: A modified motion vector multi-template self-adaptive search algorithm for motion estimation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: H.264/AVC has better compression performance because of using motion estimation based on variable block size, but it also increases computational complexity vastly, which restrict the application range of H.264/AVC. The paper draws on ideas of MMVFAST(Multi-Motion Vector Field Adaptive Search Technology), and proposes a modified motion vector multi-template self-adaptive search algorithm of motion estimation, which can reduce the computational complexity of motion estimation effectively. Experimental results show it can retrench time cost of motion estimation and improve speed of encoding greatly on condition that the reconstructed image quality and bit rate keep invariant.

articleTitle: Research on the Multi Sub-Cycle dynamic bandwidth allocation algorithm
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Triple play is the direction of business development for PON network. Current bandwidth allocation algorithms have many problems such as fairness between ONUs, poor light load, lack of differentiated QoS guarantees and so on, when they are used in the multi-service transport network. Based on the analysis of current PON bandwidth allocation algorithms, this paper research an improved dynamic bandwidth allocation algorithm for difficult problems of QoS in Multi-service transmission, which is named Multi Sub-Cycle dynamic bandwidth allocation (MSC-DBA) algorithm. MSC-DBA algorithm divides a complete polling cycle into two subcycles, which are used for priority forwarding and conventional forwarding. According to the service priorities in PON network, this algorithm sends different service queues of each ONU to PF and CF sub-cycles for respectively transmission. When the system is in the PF sub-cycle, ONU sends only EF queues, AF and BE queues remain in the cache. Until the EF sub-cycle is exhausted into the CF sub-cycle, the system will send AF and BE queues, according certain rules. It avoids the low priority and high priority services to snatch time slot, increasing high priority service delay in the effective bandwidth. Through pressure simulation for Multi-service transmission, compared with IPACT and T-DBA algorithms. It can be verified that MSC-DBA has certain advantages for efficient bandwidth allocation, which can be applied to the high QoS requirements in multi-service scenarios.

articleTitle: Evaluation on performance of technology diffusion based on AHP in high-tech industry cluster
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
