abstract: High efficiency of technology diffusion in high-tech industry cluster contribute to the quick stable and coordinate development of corporations in high-tech industry cluster and give full play to the high-tech industry cluster functioning as growth pole as well as advancing the economical development of the whole region at large. This paper attempts to evaluate the performance of technology diffusion of hi-tech industry cluster by using Analytic Hierarchy Process and taking Shanghai Zhang Jiang High-tech Park as the example.

articleTitle: A coordinator-centered energy-balance routing algorithm based on tree structure
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: In view of the lack of node energy considerations in ZigBee specification, this paper proposes an improved energy-balance routing algorithm based on tree structure, simulation results show that routing algorithm taking into account the energy factor can effectively balance the node energy consumption and reduce node death, it provides a theoretical basis and guidance to use the ZigBee technology in medical monitoring and Other areas.

articleTitle: Mashup service release based on SOAP and REST
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: In recent years,with more and more Mashup services appering, this paper proposed the solution to Mashup service release based on SOAP and REST. This paper introduces the Mashup service architecture of three layer system, discusses the function of each layer, and supports the rapid generation of Mashup services and service management. At the same time, in this architecture the paper introducts the details of the SOAP and the REST Web service design and implementation, completes the registration, operation, updation and delete of the Mashup service in a variety of ways, and enhances the compatibility.

articleTitle: Chinese entity recognition of mobile phone platform based on conditional random field
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Entity recognition of Chinese is a bask test for natural language entity, and Chinese entity recognition of mobile phone is also an issue for natural language proceeding. Our works is focus on retrieve and applications for mobile phone platform entity. The main points of this paper include: 1. Construction of knowledge based for Chinese entity recognition. 2. We use conditional random field (CRF) by probabilistic models to segment and label sequence data. 3. There are many applications can be found based on relation extraction. In this paper we just description two applications, entity search engines and Smartphone.

articleTitle: A new procedure for the integration of computer aided design and analysis
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: This paper demonstrated that the computational geometry can be systematically and exactly converted into ANCF finite element description using a linear transformation. This linear transformation does not distort the geometry and preserves the desirable features of the ANCF finite elements including the constant mass matrix. As discussed in this paper, it is necessary to introduce a rational ANCF to convert the rational Bezier and NURBS curve into ANCF elements. The rational Bezier curve representation can be considered as a special case of the RANCF cable finite element developed in this investigation.

articleTitle: Ant-genetic algorithms based on multi-objective optimization
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: In this paper, a new algorithm called multi-objective ant-genetic algorithms, which is based on the continuous space optimization is presented to solve constrained multi-objective function optimization problems. For the trait of multi-objective optimization, we define the pheromone instruction inheritance searching strategy and the method of pheromone updating. Then we combine four means of pheromone instruction inheritance searching, introduction of excellent decision-making, decision set updating and changing algorithm termination condition together so that the constringent speed of searching has improved a lot and the quantity of Pareto optimal decisions were controlled, also the distributing area of decisions were enlarged, the diversity of the swarm was maintained. At the same time, the termination conditions of multi-objective ant-genetic algorithms were presented. In the end, an example was listed to prove that the algorithms were effective, and it can find a group of widely distributed Pareto optimal decisions.

articleTitle: An effective image fusion rule based on Consistency Checking
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: This paper puts forward a novel fusion rule for multiscale image decomposition: PCA is applied to approximation images and Consistency Checking to detail images after energy selection. Improving the continuity of the images, this rule overcomes some weaknesses of the traditional approaches. In image fusion applications, especially multisource images, it seems more meaningful to combine regions rather than pixels. The fusion algorithms based on the traditional fusion rules that we have discussed in section 2 are mainly pixel-based approaches where each individual coefficient of the multi-scale decomposition (or possibly the coefficients in a small fixed window) is treated more or less independently. As an intermediate step from pixel-based toward region-based fusion schemes, this paper proposed the Consistency Checking approach. Such approach has the additional advantage that the fusion process becomes more robust and may help to circumvent some of the well-known drawbacks of pixel-based techniques.

articleTitle: Experiment and MATLAB simulation of electric power steering system based on permanent magnet AC servo motor
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Comparing to traditional mechanical hydraulic steering, electric power steering system has the advantages of high efficiency, fast reaction velocity, safety and pollution free, although DC servo motor is generally adopted at present. This work proposes experiment and MATLAB simulation of electric power steering system based on permanent magnet AC servo motor, to prove that permanent magnet AC servo motor can be used in electric power steering system, and has immense superiority and development potential.

articleTitle: An efficient and low cost monitoring system to improve availability and reliability of grid services
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: In the Grid and cloud computing systems, resources are shared among a large number of applications and users. These systems, as efficient environments, can be used for execution of long-running distributed applications. The failure occurrence during critical long-running applications can lead to spend considerable time and cost. This paper proposes an efficient job and resource monitoring services to attain the needed degree of availability and reliability of long-life application. In addition to the quality of services, the other focus of this work is to minimize resource consumption and the cost of requested services in the economic grid. The dynamic nature of proposed monitoring service leads to improve the availability and reliability of grid resources/services with low resource consumption. Analytical approach (Markov approach) is used to analyze the effect of our service on the availability and reliability of grid services/resources in the presence of permanent and transient faults.

articleTitle: Research of watermark-embedded rules' performance based on DWT
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: An important issue in the research of Digital Watermarking is the trade-off between invisibility and robustness of the watermark. Based on the actual application, the digital watermark embedding rules mainly consist of additive embedding rule, multiplicative embedding rule, and embedding rule based on regional integration technology. In order to achieve the best purpose, this article tests a variety of common image attacks through the digital watermark anti-aggressive in combination with different embedded rules, and provides guidance and reference for the choice and application of the watermark methods while detecting strengths and weaknesses of different embedding rules' performance.

articleTitle: mVoIP Service attack and authentication mechanism on a Smart work device
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Mobile VoIP(mVoIP) Service on Smart work device provides both wide-area (cellular) access and local-area technology for Voice over IP services with a smart phone. Therefore, we should analyze the service security threat to solve security vulnerability of the SIP base mVoIP service in a wireless smart work environment. However, new problems and service vulnerabilities have been found on mVoIP services. In this paper, we examined the weaknesses about additional service provided in the commercial mVoIP network. In addition, we presented a possible authentication mechanism using voice data on mobile VoIP service.

articleTitle: An improved range query algorithm on over-DHT based P2P network
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: P2P network is a focus research field with rapid development in recent years. Distributed hash tables (DHT for short) schemes are the core technique to locate and search resources in structured P2P network. However, due to the characteristic of DHT that its hash method destroy data locality, DHT only support exact-match search, cannot support complex search process. A simple and flexible solution has been built to tackle the problem which is known as over-DHT paradigm without need to modify existing DHT infrastructures which significantly decreases the complexity of deployment. Among the well known over-DHT paradigms now, LIGHT is an elegant one. It provides more efficient complex query methods than other paradigms and also reduces the paradigm maintenance cost. However, LIGHT does not make full use of the advantages of space partition tree such as that it is a complete binary tree and divides data space into uniform interval in each level of the tree. In this paper, we propose an improved range query algorithm, Upper Boundary Predictably Lookup (UBPL for short) to reduce the DHT-lookup times during range query procedure in LIGHT. We also proved the effectiveness of UBPL by simulating experiments.

articleTitle: The implementation method and improvement of media piug-in in SecondLife 3D platform
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: With the rapid development of virtual reality technology, more and more industry sector begins to research and expand this technology for the use of its own characteristics. In order to meet the general or the special functional requirements better, the continuous improvement and optimization of 3D virtual platform have become the hot spot of research now. This paper obtains a general development methods for 3D virtual platform, relying on the deep understanding of operating mechanism of the video media plug-in in SecondLife. On this basis, it completes the upgrade of the video media plug-in which will meet the needs of playing more video formats now.

articleTitle: Study based on thermal infrared image
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: In recent years infrared thermal imaging technology widely used in industrial, commercial and military, the typical applications include video conferencing, fire, security systems, automotive collision avoidance systems, and military missile systems. These applications have increasing demands for Infrared images, but because of the performance of infrared detectors and the working environment, the infrared image has low quality. In this paper, 14 bits data were collected by the infrared imaging system ThermaCAMP30 and image processing algorithms were studied in ASIC (Application Specific Integrated Circuit), where, the algorithms include one point correction, two correction, dead pixel replacement, histogram stretching, and image enhancement algorithms. The experiment results enhanced the visual effects of 8 bits image, enhanced the contrast of the background and objects, restrained noise and improved the detail of infrared thermal image.

articleTitle: Density-based top-k outlier detection on uncertain objects
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Outlier detection is an important task in data mining and has been well studied on precise data. However, outlier detection on uncertain objects is particularly challenging. In this paper, firstly, the conceptions about density-based top-k uncertain outlier detection are defined. Secondly, an algorithm of density-based Top-k outlier detection on uncertain objects is proposed, the time complexity of which is polynomial. Finally, the experiment illustrates the effectiveness and efficiency of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Kinematic analysis of a class of multi-DOF tendon-driven minimally invasive surgical instruments
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Each servo motor was installed on the base and servo motor torque was transmitted to each joint through a tendon-and-pulley system to reduce volume and to get compact surgical instruments in robot-assisted minimally invasive surgery. In this paper, a class of multi-DOF tendon-driven minimally invasive surgical instrument was designed and corresponding forward kinematic and inverse kinematic were analyzed based on the product of exponentials formula, and Paden and Kahan subproblems. Due to the tendon-driven surgical instrument existing motion coupling, the relationships of the tendon-driven multi-DOF surgical instrument between actuator space and joint space were derived to achieve joint motion decoupling. The analysis method can be useful for motion analysis and control for tendon-driven robotic mechanisms with open&close function.

articleTitle: A hybrid channel hopping scheme for Wireless Sensor Networks Based on IEEE 802.15.4
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: To possess more sensor nodes and maximize the capacity of future networks, anti-interference technology becomes one of the important research subjects in Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs). The previous studies indicate that the dynamic timeslot allocation and channel hopping can solve the interference problem, while a pure channel hopping technology may lose other network performances. Combined with the dynamic resource allocation (DRA) and the theory of the channel hopping technology, this paper proposes a hybrid channel hopping scheme for WSNs based on IEEE 802.15.4. In this scheme, it introduces two channel modes (channel hopping mode and channel adaption mode). Nodes select the channel mode, dynamically apply for a channel or timeslots by DRA request, and automatically switch the channel mode according to the channel condition. The experimental results show that the proposed scheme can effectively improve the anti-interference capability and enhance the network capacity.

articleTitle: Research on supervision mechanism of government information service outsourcing
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: The outsourcing of government information service constitutes an effective way to resolve the contradiction between demand and supply of government information. By means of constructing a evolutionary game model, we can come to conclusions that whether the government will choose to supervise the supplier is closely related to the supervision cost, penalty of malfeasance, fine for supplier's violation of regulations; besides, the supplier's choice to obey the regulations is also closely related to a host of factors such as the benefits from violating regulations; service cost, bonus and intangible benefits of obeying regulations; service cost, penalty and intangible loss of violating regulations; probability of violation being found. Altering the above parameters can exercise a great influence on the strategy choice by the two parties.

articleTitle: The conversion from line drawings to paintings with paper-cutting designs
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: The craft of paper-cutting is part of the folk art traditions of cultures all over the world. If we could convert such arts works as comic strips, line drawings, gongbi paintings and calligraphy which are displayed by lines to paintings with paper-cutting designs, there will be broad application prospect. This paper converts grayscale images to binary images with the use of the combination of automatic processing and users' selection with multiple thresholds; in the conversion from the line drawings to paintings with paper-cutting designs, the system first calculates the numbers of the regions and then different regions will be connected automatically according to the principle of proximity. Simultaneously, the function of users' selection is added considering the stability of paper-cuttings. After the vectorization of the resulting designs, beautiful and elaborate paper-cuttings are generated with the use of automatic carving machines.

articleTitle: Analysis and suggestions for the security of web applications
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: As an essential and significant part of network security, the security of web applications has received more and more attentions at present. In this paper, we review the security of current web applications, and enumerate the most common attacks on them such as injection, cross site scripting, and insecure direct object references. Then by taking injection attack as an example, we explain the principles of injection attack and analyze the reasons for the vulnerability. Finally, to prevent these attacks, we provide several valuable suggestions.

articleTitle: A wireless access control system based on CDMA and DTMF technologies
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: This design has realized a wireless access control system combined CDMA voice intercom and DTMF coding identification technologies. The wireless access control system could also update user data real-timely through CDMA network. The concrete passing time of residents and visitors from the access control system can be recorded real-timely to benefit the security maintenance. This design consists of following hardware configurations and corresponding circuits: ARM central control system, CDMA communication system, DTMF coding system, cap-sensor touch button, etc. This access control system creatively puts forward CDMA as the communication medium, and takes ARM as main control unit. It has completed the entire communication and control functions, and taken the cost into consideration. Until now, it is rare to see such products or designs that use similar communication technologies.

articleTitle: Metrics for service granularity in Service Oriented Architecture
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Service Oriented Architecture (SOA) is becoming an increasingly popular architectural style for many organizations due to the promised agility, flexibility benefits. One of the prominent principles of designing services is the matter of how abstract services should be i.e. granularity. Since service-oriented analysis and design methods lack on providing a quantitative metric for service granularity level evaluation, identification of optimally granular services is the key challenge in service-oriented solution development. This paper is divided into three types of services, and listed on the properties of service granularity. Various properties of the three service types the weight is not the same, in order to get the appropriate service granularity, Using the analytic hierarchy process analysis of the attributes in each service type.

articleTitle: Improved PCA facial recognition with bootstrap and data standardization in small sample case
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Based on the traditional principal component analysis (PCA) in facial recognition, first this paper proposes an bootstrap resampling method in PCA to overcome the small sample problem in the process of data mean centering. Second this paper uses the data standardization to improve the mean centering process. Experiments suggest that the proposed method is much better than the traditional PCA in facial recognition.

articleTitle: Design for downhole wireless location system based on ZIGBEE wireless sensor network
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: For the current situation that coal mine accidents happen frequently, the level of the technology of miners positioning and alarm system is low, this paper presents a method to establish a wireless location net (WLN) based RSSI and the application of CC2430/2431 chips. This WLN can be compatible with the most of current mine safety monitoring system, and it can provide miners orientation data and underground personnel safety information for upper monitor PC. This paper firstly presents the three parts of the wireless network: Coordinator Node, Router Node, Blind Node. Then introduce the detailed design of the Communication protocol. Finally explain the wireless location algorithm in this system.

articleTitle: A trusted model for service selection in trustworthy service composition
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Service selection is a great challenge in trustworthy web service composition. This paper proposes a complete and practical model by improving an existing model based on trust and reputation for selecting trusted services. This new model overcomes five shortcomings of the old one, which are about entity (web service) description, cold start of algorithm, weighting component service (services participate in the composition), distinguishing rater and weighting different trust source.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of a QoS router on FPGA
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Router is the key unit of Network-on-Chip and there are many implementations of router for on chip network, but few of them provide QoS service. In this paper, we have exploited a QoS router based on a hybrid switching mechanism. By using the circuit-switching, the router can provide guaranteed services, at the same time it makes the most use of the remained network resources to provide best effort services with the wormhole-switching. What's more, to be able to implement it on chip lastly, we select the XC5VLX110T chip to establish a verification platform on RTL-level, also with some necessary analysis and verification. The synthesis of the router shows it consumes 1% of the chip's storage resources and 6% of the logic resources, and its maximum operating frequency is up to 155.441MHz when the width of the wire is set to be 8bit and the depth of buffer to be 16 flits.

articleTitle: Research and develope of badminton sports video retrieval system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Content-based sports video retrieval becomes an important branch of multimedia retrieval which is free from traditional manual text labeling. A content-based retrieval system of Badminton sports video based on visual feature is researched and developed in this paper. A Badminton video is first automatically segmented into many sub-clips based on visual features, and then similar video clips can be obtained using sliding sub-clip window algorithm and matching function, among these sub-clips, similar video clips are ranked by a sorting model. The experimental results showed that our system could effectively and efficiently retrieve similar Badminton sports video corresponding with a query clip.

articleTitle: Interactive control for viewing 3D objects based on MFC and OpenGL
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: The construction of 3D objects and their viewing control are key problem during 3D visualization process. General procedures for developing application software based on MFC and OpenGL were proposed according to object-oriented programming methodology and thus a GLView class was derived from CView class. Spherical coordinates were adopted to characterize the observation point's position and the view direction. The transformation formula of twisting, translating, rotating and scaling were deduced according coordinate transform rule between global world coordinates and local view coordinates. An OOP algorithm was developed to finish these transformations by the response of a mouse or keyboard message, a dialog or a Timer. It was demonstrated by many cases that both the intuitive control and the quantitative control for viewing 3D objects have been provided conveniently.

articleTitle: Analysis and research models of the Estimation of Distribution Algorithms
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: The Estimation of Distribution Algorithms (EDAs) is a novel class of evolutionary algorithms which is motivated by the idea of building probabilistic graphical model of promising solutions to represent linkage information between variables in chromosome. Through learning of and sampling from probabilistic graphical model, new population is generated and optimization procedure is repeated until the stopping criteria are met. In this paper, the mechanism of the Estimation of Distribution Algorithms is analyzed. Currently existing EDAs are surveyed and categorized according to the probabilistic model they used, then the strengths and weakness and the future perspective of EDAs are concluded.

articleTitle: Application of support vector regression in beamforming
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Support vector machine (SVM) has shown several advantages in prediction, regression, and estimation over some of the classical approaches. The new approach that support vector regression (SVR) applied to the array beamforming is proposed in this paper. Training data and test data on the effects of SVR Beamforming are researched. The new method has been applied in the environment of noise and interference, and is compared with uniform weighted beamforming. It has found that the array beamforming using SVR has the ability of suppression interference. Finally, effectiveness of the new method is verified through computer simulation.

articleTitle: Research of reliable trusted boot in embedded systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Since embedded systems have been widely used and integrated into almost all the electronic systems, the security and reliability of embedded system must not be ignored. In order to improve the security and reliability of embedded system, a feasible way is to establish root of trust and trusted boot to ensure the integrity and security of the system. This paper proposes Reliable Trusted Boot to provide a reliable and tamper-resistant embedded system. Our method adds extended trusted platform module and backup-recovery mechanism to traditional embedded system, controls the start sequence of platform's components, enforces trusted boot and recovers the system when necessary. Our implementation demonstrates the feasibility of Reliable Trusted Boot, it enhance the security and reliability of embedded system.

articleTitle: Security enhanced design of the Bluetooth simple pairing protocol
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: A deep research on the Bluetooth simple pairing protocol is done to improve its security vulnerabilities. Applying the key agreement protocol based on LUC system, a security enhanced protocol is designed, which is combined with the characteristics of Bluetooth Piconet. Experiment results demonstrate that the protocol can not only resist impersonation, replay attack and man in the middle attack, but also need little time and is convenient for user.

articleTitle: The research on the query optimization on the distributed heterogeneous database based on the response time
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: The user's response time was an important indicator for the heterogeneous database which locate in the different network. This paper describes the structure of the distributed heterogeneous database system of query optimization system based on the Hibernate technical for the B/S structure, and analysis the calculation of the response time. Finally an example was used to demonstrate the feasibility and practicability of query optimization.

articleTitle: Dependability modeling and analysis for the virtual clusters
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: The modeling and dependability analysis of virtualization system is always challenging due to the particular characteristic and mechanism of virtualization, in this paper we attempt to modeling virtual clusters using a hierarchical method combining a upper-layer Reliability Block Diagram (RBD) model and a lower-layer Markov model. Taking into account both the failure of physical servers and the virtual machines, the Markov model for one cluster is established while the RBD model reveals an overall structure of virtual clusters as well. The dependability of which three attributes are concentrated including availability, reliability and maintainability in this paper, is then theoretically analyzed by solving the proposed hybrid model, some useful advices are suggested to design an effective virtualization system with required dependability in according to the numerical results.

articleTitle: The study of MAC protocol fairness for WBANs
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: The IEEE 802.15.4 standard is specifically devised to support low power, low data rate in relation to Wireless Body Area Network (WBAN). It is pointed out that weaknesses of channel allocation unfairness when using DCF access control scheme due to its inherent nature of binary exponentially backoff algorithm. So, this paper proposes an improved back off algorithm in slotted CSMA/CA, to dynamically change the minimum contention window each time CSMA/CA begins, according to the network load conditions. The presented based on Two-dimensional Markov chain model. Theoretical analysis and simulation results show that the proposed algorithm can decrease the collision ratio and the retransmission ratio, resulting significant power saving and throughput improvement when the traffic load is high.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of multi-channel digital down-converter based on DSP
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Aiming at multi-channel IF signal processing requirements, the paper designed and implemented a multi-channel digital down-converter. Based on functional requirements and technical indexes, the implementation structure of multi-channel digital down-converter was designed and overall functional diagram was given. Functions and constitutes of each module within FPGA were described in detail. The test on function and performance of multi-channel digital down-converter system was conducted. Test method, flow and test result analysis were performed in sequence. After strict test, result shows that the digital down-converter can ensure normal and stable working of system, which can also achieve appropriate indexes.

articleTitle: Analysis and research on the difference between data warehouse and database
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: The authors introduced the development and conception of data warehouse and database and research the relationship between database and data warehouse, and have studied the difference between their technology. At last discuss the combination and application of the database,and date warehouse technology.

articleTitle: A cooperative localization method based on conjugate gradient and Taylor series expansion algorithms
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Taylor series expansion method based on TDOA (Time Difference of Arrival) is a typical location algorithm in cellular mobile telecommunication system, but its performance depends highly on the selection of initial position because of convergence problem. A new cooperative localization method based on conjugate gradient and Taylor series expansion algorithms is presented to solve this problem. The convergence and computation efficiency are improved by using the result of conjugate gradient method as the initial position in Taylor series expansion method. By comparing with those analogous algorithms, one is using the result of Chan algorithm, and the other is using the result of least square method, as the initial position in Taylor series expansion method, the computer simulation results indicate that the new algorithm has higher computation efficiency than that two analogous algorithms. Simulation results also show that the location accuracy and computation efficiency of the new algorithm can approach the performance obtained by Taylor series expansion method based on true position as the initial position.

articleTitle: Multi-scale edge detection in the EMD domain using the adaptive noise threshold
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: A multi-scale edge detection in the EMD domain using the median absolute deviation to estimate the noise threshold is proposed to detect the edges of noisy signals with different signal to noise ratios. The new algorithm first calculates the slope of the EMD residuals in scales. Second it eliminates the noise in the slope signal by thresholding, the noise threshold of which is estimated by the median absolute deviation. At last, it output the edge information by the spatial consistence test. Simulation results show that, the multi-scale edge detection in the EMD domain using the adaptive noise threshold can accurately detect the edges of signals, and suppress the noise.

articleTitle: An optimal design of LVDS interface
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: An optimal design of LVDS interface method is present in this paper; the design is optimalized from the hardware circuit and interface logic respectively. Through measurement and analysis of the output signal, it is found that the long cable is the main reason for missing lock of chipset. Therefore, at the transmitter and receiver differential signal drive and adaptive cable equalizer are added to ensure reliable and stable of the interface. Meanwhile, the interface logic design has been optimized, and two optimization methods are proposed. Through analysis and comparison, the second is chosen in the project, and is tested extensively, which shows that the method can effectively avoid the loss lock of chipset, and can improve data transmission speed.

articleTitle: Application of visual prolog on stratigraphic correlation and connection
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Using the advantages of Visual Prolog language in the process of knowledge representation and logical reasoning, based on borehole sample data, this paper discusses the methods of stratigraphic correlation and connection. We establish a system architecture, which consists of knowledge acquisition system, fact database, rule database, knowledge management system, reasoning machine and the man-machine interface. This paper mainly introduces the structure of stratigraphic correlation and connection knowledge database. Next, it focus on how to use visual prolog to represent facts and rules, establish knowledge database, and how to implement intelligent reasoning by using SLD-Resolution with cut, fails and other control mechanisms. In order to confirm the practical result of this method, we test it with some data. The results show the method is effective.

articleTitle: Improved TRIAD for star sensor
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: TRIAD is an attitude determination algorithm, which only uses two observed vectors to calculate the attitude of spacecrafts. It has disadvantage of asymmetry using the two observed vectors and not making full use of all the observed star vectors captured by the star sensor. This paper presented an Improved TRAID algorithm to solve the problems above. It integrates all observed vectors on the basis of linear estimation theory. Comparing the experiment results of Improved TRIAD algorithm with the Traditional TRIAD and QUEST algorithm, it shows that the Improved TRAID algorithm can get higher attitude accuracy than the other two algorithms.

articleTitle: A energy balanced deployment for linear wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Linear wireless sensor networks are characterized by a linear topology and multihop forwarding patterns. Sensors closer to the base station are usually required to forward a large amount of traffic for sensors farther from the base station, leading to the environment cannot be effectively monitored. The energy consumption balance is achieved in the paper by adjusting the distance between nodes. The distance of nodes near the base station become short because they have to forward the more traffic. The node deployment is converted to optimization problems of distance distribution between nodes. The network lifetime under different number of forwarding region is discussed. Simulation results show that this deployment strategy obtains the energy consumption balance.

articleTitle: The application of information technology in intangible cultural heritage protection under all-media vision
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: With the expansion of intangible cultural heritage protection and its study area, the spatial information technology and digital technology has become an important method to recognize culture, track history, find out spatial distribution rules of cultural heritage, establish cultural heritage information management system, and reproduce intangible cultural heritage. It also opens a new window of technology for intangible cultural heritage protection. Under the all-media vision, this thesis analyzes the application and development trends of spatial information technology and digital technology in intangible cultural heritage protection.

articleTitle: Research on thermal comfort model of hot summer and cold winter zone based on RBF neural network
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: In order to establish the human thermal comfort model, factors are acquired by data acquisition and survey. Using RBF neural network, the human thermal comfort model in hot summer and cold winter zone is established. Moreover, expanding the experimental scope to validate the model, the experimental results have proved that the evaluation of the model is more accurate and effective.

Author Keywords: hot summer and cold winter zone

articleTitle: Research financial market based on fuzzy c-means clustering
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: The financial market is the important component part of civil economy, especially dominant securities business. So how to analyze exactly influence factor of financial market in all lines that is concerned universally by researchers. In order to further quantify key factor of securities business wave, my article combines with fuzzy c-means (FCM), aiming at this information of advancing benchmark deposit rate in all previous events by PBC, comparing with securities business, the empirical results indicate that the reaction of securities business is awfully obvious after the changing.

articleTitle: A method of skin color identification based on color classification
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: This paper describes a method to identify human skin region in an image on a color classification result. The method classifies the colors of all pixels in the image into several classes through K-means algorithm and segments the image into several parts according to the color class that each pixel belongs. Each class of color is represented by a color feature vector. Find the class whose feature vector has the minimum distance to the skin color feature vector previously defined in the color space. Take this class as human-skin color in this image and the skin color region can be identified. This method does not need an accurate skin color model which can only be obtained through resource-costing training processes. It offers a relatively simple way to find the regions that is most similar to skin color and so to identify the regions as skin regions. Experiment results are shown to prove the effectiveness.

articleTitle: Construction and visualization of rice roots model based on artificial life
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: In the paper, we firstly introduce two important virtual plant modeling methods, dual-scale automata and L-system. Then, according to structure characteristics of rice root, we construct the morphological structure model of rice root using the combination of dual-scale automaton and L-system. In view of environment factors that affect growth of rice root, we build the growth restricted model of rice root, and combine it with the morphological structure model, achieving the dynamic growth simulation of rice root.

articleTitle: Mining product features and opinions based on pattern matching
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Acquiring available information from product reviews can not only instruct consumers to consume rationally, but also help companies to improve competitiveness and their products' quality. A method based on pattern matching for mining features and opinions is proposed in this paper according to the characteristics of Chinese reviews. First, the reviews are segmented into fragments with relatively simple structures, and then different patterns are adopted to match fragments with different structures in order to mine the features and opinions in reviews. Finally a method based on features grouping was used to prune, which can keep both infrequent features and the comprehensiveness of mining results. Experimental results show that the method is effective.

articleTitle: Unscented FastSLAM for UAV
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) is a necessary prerequisite to make mobile vehicle truly autonomous, which is a hot research topic today. FastSLAM as a successful SLAM method abstracts many researchers' attentions. FastSLAM factors the SLAM problem into a localization problem and a mapping problem in which the landmark position is estimated by EKF. A modified FastSLAM is presented for uninhabited aerial vehicle (UAV), using UKF to replace the EKF to estimate the landmark position. So we can improve the estimation precision, at the same time no need to linearize the sensor observation model and to compute its Jacobian matrix.

articleTitle: Research on the key technologies for Tibetan Web search and knowledge discovery based on Conception Relevance
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Conception Relevance means the concept newly emerged in the study of relational Web. It refers to the texts of a Web page are relevant to another page's content and the relevance is based on the concepts of some words in the texts. This paper aims to establish a comprehensive and accurate knowledge database and construct a Tibetan conception relevance search engine system by acquiring Tibetan Web data, clustering and searching conception relevance data of Tibetan Web as well as gathering comprehensive information of conception relevance data set of Tibetan Web.

articleTitle: Research on appraisal system of transport network planning project in corridor
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Revising the basic concept of transport corridor, it wound introduce its theory evidence for the network planning project. By analyzing the key issues affecting the shape and framework of transport corridor, five qualitative indices was put forward with each one's detail reference. Then seven groups of indices were found out with each formula by analyzing which one rational transport system should have, it included that the total length of each transport mode should spread to certain extent, and different transport modals should divide the transport work rationally, and that all the transport network investment should be limited to a fixed ratio relative to its GDP, the layout of transport network should accommodate to the OD distribution, and that the transportation networks designing aims should take into account the restrict of natural resource such as lands occupancy. As a result, a multilayer fuzzy appraisal system was set up by introducing the fuzzy mathematics method.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of flight control system software for unmanned helicopter
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: In this paper, we address the design of software that achieves stable, reliable feather for an unmanned helicopter's flight control system. According to the logical view and data view are given to the flight control system, the method of software architecture is researched. At last, the results of this work are illustrated by experiment, showing that the software base on this architecture has well stability and reliability.

articleTitle: Multiple voltage assignment based on PSO
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: today the power optimization has become a crucial concern in modern IC design. Multiple supply voltage (MSV) is efficient way to achieve low power. Most of the researches are carried out in the simulated annealing scheme. In this paper, a novel particle swarm optimization approach was proposed for multiple voltage islands generations at the post-floorplanning. This PSO was applied for resolving MVA with new operators. We have carried the experiments to demonstrate the feasibility of PSO. Simulation results are shown to be effective in voltage islands generation.

articleTitle: Pricing the convertible bonds under complex call trigger condition with Longstaff and Schwartz Model
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: This article presents a method to price the convertible bonds under complex call trigger condition, where the issuer can only call the convertible bonds if the underlying stock price exceeds a certain level for a pre-defined number of days in a pre-defined period. Because of the path-dependent feature of the trigger condition, we employ the Longstaff and Schwartz Model, which is based on the Monte Carlo simulation. And this approach inherits the advantage of the Longstaff and Schwartz Model, which is intuitive, accurate, and computational efficient. We have also done some numerical test to show the impact of the condition and the dependence of the convertible price on the major factors.

articleTitle: Watershed segmentation based on gradient reconstruction and region merging
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: A new method of watershed segmentation is proposed based on gradient reconstruction and region merging. Non-linear transformation and morphological opening-reconstruction and closing - reconstruction are used to modify the gradient image. Furthermore, some small segmentation regions are incorporated into the near bigger regions which is based on criterion of the average gray value of the region, and according to the contrast control and the edge strength criterion. The experimental results show that this method has good robustness and adaptability which can settle the over-segmentation problem effectively.

articleTitle: Certificateless-based two-party authenticated key agreement protocols in a multiple PKG environment
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: To date, most identity-based key agreement protocols are based on a single PKG (Private Key Generator) environment. However, it is not realistic to assume that all schemes use a single PKG and each PKG shares identical system parameters but possesses a distinct master key. Recently, Lee et al. proposed an ID-based 2-party key agreement protocol between users whose private keys were issued by independent PKGs that do not share any system parameters. However, Lee et al. protocol has a flaw that allows attackers to impersonate others without knowing their private keys and the key escrow issues inherited in the identity-based schemes. In this paper, we propose a new certificateless-based two party authenticated key agreement protocol based on bilinear pairings in elliptic curves between users belonging to different PKGs that do not share identical system parameters. Compared with other two-party key agreement protocols for a multiple PKG environment, the proposed key agreement protocols satisfy every security requirements of key agreement protocols.

articleTitle: Application of neighborhood feature in point clouds registration
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: A point clouds registration method based on the invariant features of neighborhood points is proposed. Firstly, the target point set are weighted. Secondly, all the corresponding point-pairs are searched by comparing the feature value and then the preliminary registration is completed. Finally, to register accurately by using the ICP algorithm, this has improved the invariant feature. Experiments indicate the good results of the preliminary registration and the better results of the fine registration, which have met the requirement of registering point clouds from different viewpoints.

articleTitle: A new proposed handoff scheme for mobile communication systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: There are many studies dealt with handoff management in mobile communication systems and some of these studies presented handoff schemes to manage this important process in cellular network. All previous schemes used relative signal strength (RSS) measurements. In this work, a new proposed handoff scheme had been presented depending not only on the RSS measurements but also used the threshold distance and neighboring BSS power margins in order to improve the handoff management process. We submitted here a threshold RSS as a condition to make a handoff when a mobile station moves from one cell to another this at first, then we submitted also a specified margin between the current received signal and the ongoing BS's received signal must be satisfied in order to transfer opening call within new cell, finally we submitted again a threshold distance to exceed by a mobile station in order handoff process is done. The purpose of all these thresholds is to decrease the unnecessary handoffs that can be happened and causing either handoff delayed or call dropped. Our simulation results illustrated that the new proposed scheme is sufficiently improved the handoff process with reducing the unnecessary handoffs as compared with other schemes.

articleTitle: Path planning and simulation of the circumferential placement process on conical shell surface
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Automatic placement technology is an advanced molding technology for composite materials developed in recent decades, which have been widely used in manufacturing process of high-performance composite materials. In this paper, we proposed a new placement method, i.e., the circumferential placement, which is appropriate for conical shell surface. The model of placement linetype was designed, which build the mathematical foundation for the movement locus of placement equipment. Using three-dimensional software, the placement path was simulated, and the results verified that this method is feasible for manufacturing process of high-performance composite materials.

articleTitle: Research on gravitation potential filed based moving strategy for mobile node in sweep coverage of wireless sensor network
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Environment physical parameters about the energy efficiency status in building can be monitored with wireless sensor network with mobile node. With the non-continuous features of monitoring area in space and time, sweep coverage in wireless sensor networks is presented in this paper. To plan routes for each mobile node for sweep coverage, gravitation potential filed based moving strategy in sweep coverage is given in this paper too. To calculate the gravitation between interesting point and mobile node, dynamic mass of interesting point is introduced as the measurement for the urgent grade of interesting point. Experiment results shows that the moving strategy for sweep coverage based on gravitation potential filed can plan routes for mobile node in sweep coverage effectively.

articleTitle: Progressive refinement for clustering spatio-temporal semantic trajectories
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: The discovery of spatio-temporal patterns in trajectories of moving objects can greatly influence many fields, such as animal migration analysis, weather forecasting, and mobile marketing. But Existing works have mainly focused on the geometric properties of trajectories, while the semantics and the background geographic information has rarely been addressed. The deep researches urgently need to deploy in order to effectively utilize the knowledge extracting for semantic trajectories. A progressive refinement clustering algorithm is proposed to extract meaningful patterns in those similar semantic trajectories. Firstly, the trajectory data are translated into stop sequences which can be handled as a traditional categorical dataset (a row-by-column Boolean table) by treating each stop as an attribute and each trajectory as a row. The generic transaction data clustering algorithm is employed to group the trajectories traversing common stops. Secondly, it clusters chronological sequence of stops-based trajectories again within the former results. Finally, the time attribute is added and obtain the refined clusters. Experiments show the proposed progressive refinement method can reduce the workload and runtime dramatically.

articleTitle: Millimeter wave for MIMO small antenna systems and for mobile handset
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Generally MIMO uncorrelated channel can be obtained at the price of using high antenna spacing or precoding systems which are not only awkward to the requirement of the limited space platforms but also add to complexity of implementation. In this paper the multiple- input multiple - output millimeter wave channel is studied. We assume that the system is surrounded by the scattering environments. For an achievable significant low amount of correlation channel, in order to be closed to that of uncorrelated channel, the proposed system is shown to be mountable on small platforms such as the mobile handset. As application, the performance of the orthogonal space-time block codes (OSTBC) over the channel is simulated and shown closer to that of uncorrelated channel.

articleTitle: A Schema of Dynamic capability updating in BI-PAAS system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: This paper presents a project of dynamic capability update, this scheme will turn BI-PAAS system into a micro kernel + plug-in way, it greatly improves the system's scalability and flexibility. Through constructing a new class loader for each module and the use of XML file to record attribute information of every plug-in, it realizes module independence, and it realizes inter-communication between modules through the extension-point and extension mechanism.

articleTitle: XML data island and AJAX.NET application in the network test system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: This paper describes the XML data island and AJAX.NET technology and their respective characteristics, by combining AJAX.NET and XML technologies in ASP.NET; it achieves the no refresh data binding in the network examination system, and greatly improves the performance of data presentation, improve the user experience. AJAX.NET technology makes AJAX programming easier.

articleTitle: The cell image segmentation and classification based on OTSU method and connected region labeling
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Automatic analysis of medical cell images has been gaining more importance in pharmacology research. Segmentation and classification of cell images are the crucial steps in their analysis since results of segmentation and classification directly affect the following quantitative analysis steps. In this paper, we present a cell image segmentation and classification method based on OTSU method and connected region labeling. By K-L transform we choose one channel and ensure an automatic threshold value by OTSU method to make segmentation, then we adopt the method of connected region labeling designed by ourselves to make classification. The method has been applied to the segmentation and classification of several kinds of cell images. The experimental results show that the method is practical and effective; it has good robustness and ensures the accuracy.

articleTitle: Sensitivity enhancement of ultrasound imaging based on acoustic metamaterial
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Breast cancer is the most common and increasing cancer in the world. It is important for early diagnosis to aid in fast and effective treatment. Ultrasound imaging represents the supplement mammography in the early detection of occult breast cancer, but its sensitivity and contrast is very low. In this paper, an ultrasound imaging method is developed to detect the breast tumor by attaching a single negative metamaterial layer to detection area. The performance of the proposed method is confirmed by a full-wave simulation. It is found that the sensitivity of the proposed method is higher than that of the conventional ultrasound imaging method, and the sensitivity of the ultrasound imaging can be greatly improved by increasing the thickness of the single negative metamaterial layer adhere to detection zone. Moreover, the optimum thickness of the single negative metamaterial layer is 9 mm.

articleTitle: An advanced method of process reconstruction based on VMM
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Recently, VMM-based anti-malware systems have become a hot research topic in finding ways of overcoming the fundamental limitations of traditional host-based anti-malware systems, which are likely to be deceived and attacked by malicious codes. Guest system semantic views (e.g., files, processes) must be reconstructed to overcome the semantic gap challenge. As a result of frequent switching between processes, process reconstruction based on CR3 register causes many VM EXIT events and some performance losses. In the current study, an advanced method to reconstruct processes is presented. Utilizing the features of hardware virtualization technology, this method reduces VM EXIT events caused by process switching; thus, the efficiency of process reconstruction is improved. Experiments show that the method can reduce nearly 85% of VM EXIT events caused by process switching.

articleTitle: Research on video monitoring system based on intelligent
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Intelligent video monitoring system is that the process of monitoring is lack of human intervention, the computer vision and video analysis are applied in automatic analysis of the image sequences that camera gathers, which can achieve the position, identification and tracking of target in the dynamic scene, analyzing and judging the behavior of the target, and providing useful information with the fastest and best way, which can help security personnel effectively deal with the crisis and minimize false positives and negatives phenomenon, effectively making early warn, dealing something in the process, timely finding evidence of the intelligent monitoring system, and which is automatic, all-day and real-time monitoring.

articleTitle: S-rough graph and its properties
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: By combining classical graph theory with S-rough set, this paper constructs S-rough graph to research rough problem which has dynamic characteristic. Some basic properties of S-rough graph are presented. This paper also gives special subgraphs of S-rough graph and their properties.

articleTitle: A clustering algorithm based on Bayesian network learning system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Construction of Student Model for Bayesian network-based Intelligent Tutoring System belongs to one of the major content for individualized teaching strategies, which plays crucial role during the whole process of research. Only after the reasonable student model is established, can analysis of the learning characteristics be carried out accordingly so that learning strategy can be made for individualized learning. This paper presents an algorithm to obtain students' feature information using data mining technique. Researchers who are interested in different teaching strategy are referred to this piece of work.

articleTitle: Traffic classification using cost based decision tree
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: A novel method for achieving practical real-time traffic classification is proposed in this paper, which is based on C4.5 decision tree. Most existing traffic classification algorithms only focus on accuracy of the classification results, but lack of considering the various costs in actual deployment. So they cannot guarantee that the obtained tree construction is optimal for hardware and software processing. To solve this problem, our Cost Based Feature Evaluation procedure defines UnitGainRatio as the metric of attributes to find the best tree construction when considering the attribute acquisition and processing cost. We also introduce another method called Fuzzy Delicacy Node Selection procedure to choose the more suitable node, when their UnitGainRatio are too close to each other. The experiment results show that the proposed method reduces the average cost compared with similar algorithm.

articleTitle: The design and research of an Earthquake Early Warning System for railways
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Earthquake Early Warning System is an important subsystem of the overall planning for railway information. On the basis of the research of foreign Earthquake Early Warning System, we have analyzed disaster monitoring technology and its trends. The dangers of train's safe operation caused by earthquake and other hazards, for example, objects, animals, and humans interfering, has also been presented. Combined with the reality of high-speed railways in our country, we raised the overall system structure, network architecture, system functions and of Earthquake Early Warning System. Furthermore, not only could the system get real-time monitoring information, but also is able for centralized management, emergency procedures, and comprehensive analysis.

articleTitle: Temperature and humidity wireless sensing and monitoring systems applied in greenhouse
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Crop production in greenhouses is an increasing industry in the fields of agriculture. And greenhouse with all measures of environmental controlling and monitoring is some of the important component for crop production and protection. As you know, the most important variables in a greenhouse are temperature and relative humidity. This paper proposes a new different method aims at sensing and monitoring the temperature and humidity in greenhouse environment for different distance. The network structure used in this paper is star topology. It consists of one more sensor nodes, some repeat nodes, one main node, PC Terminal, MYSQL, web service and one real time alarm system. Based on this system, the circumstance parameters can be sensed and monitored. Once the alarm system monitors the parameters curve displays abnormally, the alarm system will inform the monitor to take some actions. Compared with the other previous proposed system, the advantage is that the sensing distance can be set as the user requirement. Although the wireless transceiver distance is limited by the battery power and it is just 1.26m, the distance can be enlarged for each node increasing 1.26m. And the total distance can be calculated as 1.26m×[1+N(Repeat Nodes)]. As the experiment results showed, this system holds low power dissipation, simple network distribution, and easy to maintain.

articleTitle: A design for Controller Area Network bus real-time monitoring system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: A net monitor system used to real-time monitor the state of the Controller Area Network (CAN) bus was designed. In the system, two while loops compose a producer consumer pattern which is the main program structure. The producer loop responds user actions and the consumer loop handles commands and data. The functions of the system such as data trace, graphics display, signal selection, and write frame are compiled in corresponding child VIs. Users can call those functions by clicking corresponding switches. While messages are transmitted in the bus, the signals that we want to monitor are real-time shown in the system. In the experiment, another CAN card is used to imitate the CAN bus that send messages to the monitoring system. The results show that the system can real-time monitor the CAN bus.

articleTitle: Research on personalized recommendation algorithm based on user model and user-project matrix
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: With the dramatic increase of the amount of network information, the phenomenon of merchandise information overload has become more and more serious. Thus, the e-commerce sites are required to provide the most needed information for customers to attract their attention. The traditional recommendation algorithm ignores the connections among user's own attributes and the changes in project scoring with each passing day. With the research of the traditional collaborative filtering recommendation algorithm, the paper put an emphasis on the combination of user model and user project matrix, and introduced the data of user attributes and the variation values of project scoring over time into the traditional recommendation algorithm. By experiment, the validity of the algorithm was confirmed.

articleTitle: A product features mining method based on association rules and the degree of property co-occurrence
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: With the rapid development of e-commerce, excavating network consumer reviews is more and more important nowadays. This paper proposes a product features mining method based on association rules and the degree of property co-occurrence. Excavating candidate features by Apriori algorithm first, then pruning the candidate features by the degree of property co-occurrence between specifiers and product features, finally excavating Non-frequent features through opinion words to supplement Apriori algorithm. Experimental results prove that the method is effective.

articleTitle: Pricing American options on assets with dividends by a Brownian bridge simulation method
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: This paper presents a Brownian bridge backward simulation method for pricing American options on assets with discrete dividends. In the traditional Monte Carlo methods, in order to determine when to exercise, we have to store the simulated asset prices at all time steps on all paths. If N time steps and M paths are used, then the storage requirement is O(M N). To overcome this disadvantage, backward simulation methods have been given, but the additional cost in the methods is needed. In this paper, we use Brownian bridge to generate paths backwardly and improve original backward simulation methods to price American options. And in the new method, the additional is not needed, and the number of storage required only grows like O(M).

articleTitle: Research on interference suppression of embedded measurement and control system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Researchers in the embedded system development and application field always care whether an embedded measurement and control system can work reliably or not. Interference is analyzed, and interference suppression measures are presented in detail. It is useful to researchers.

articleTitle: A guarantee Model based on ANP for Implementing “A plan for educating and training outstanding engineers”
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Educating and training outstanding engineers involves the government, the institution of higher learning and enterprises. The chief problems of implementing “A Plan for Educating and Training Outstanding Engineers (PETOE)” are how to build an guarantee evaluation index system and determine the guarantee index weight and interaction among indexes. In this paper, the method of Analytic Network Process (ANP) were adopted, eleven indexes, such as the policy, capital and teachers involved in implementing guarantee were analyzed, the guarantee Model and supermatrix of implementing PETOE Based on ANP were built, the SD software was used to find out the convergence state of the associated supermatrix, the stable limit supermatrix, the index weights were calculated and their total sequences of affecting indexes was sorted. The results show that the guarantee model of implementing PETOE based on ANP is reasonable.

articleTitle: 3D model retrieval based on surface color and shape
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: This paper puts forward a method of 3D model retrieval based on shape and color. First, quantization of color space; then vertexes sampling in accordance with improved method of shape distributions, obtain vertexes and color, use vertexes obtain histogram of D1 shape distribution, and use information on color architecture color histogram; Finally, normalization of histogram information, and using the method of weights combined with two kinds of information. Experimental results show that the method for 3D model retrieval has good effect is retrieval.

articleTitle: Techniques of multiple self-adjusting forecast and its application in Fcc-device
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: This article introduces the techniques of multiple self-adjusting forecast as well as its applications in catalytic cracking process. Based on its operating experiences in memory, comparison and judgments, the system is optimized to provide operating directions for the production processes. Therefore the process progressively achieves and maintains optimal state or relatively optimized state.

articleTitle: Design and analysis on emergency rescue workflow of metro construction based on Petri nets
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: In the process of emergency rescue of metro construction, faced with the following problems: multi-coordinated, rescue scene interact with the remote command center, the pool of resources inside and outside the enterprise and other process. In order to save time and improve the efficiency of the rescue, the emergency rescue procedures must ensure scientific and effective. This paper establishes emergency rescue work flow model based on the Petri nets, and the performance analysis of time for this model is included. The time consuming of whole emergency rescue process can be calculated, and the calculation results have an important guiding significance for daily emergency rescue training exercises and actual combat. Then the authors put forward the optimization ways of emergency rescue workflow.

articleTitle: Model for tectonic method of reliable internetware based on monitoring
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: For internetware is open, dynamic and changeable, we design a tectonic model of reliable internetware based on monitoring, which dynamically evaluates the reliability degree with the running of internetware, and modifies internetware and monitoring parameters according to the monitoring results. Our method provides dynamic reliability support for internetware and enhances the reliability degree of internetware gradually.

articleTitle: Ridgelet Probabilistic Neural Network with Genetic Algorithm selecting center vectors
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: To enhance the generalization performance of conventional Probabilistic Neural Network, a novel model of Probabilistic Neural Network is proposed in this paper. Ridgelet basis functions satisfying admissible condition are adopted as the activation functions in radial basis layer of the model. To reduce the size of the network and determine the parameters of ridgelet functions including the directions, locations and scales, Genetic Algorithm is utilized to select the optimal central vectors of pattern layer. Then, the normalized central vectors are taken as the direction parameters, the location parameters are all set to 1, and the scales are obtained in the training process of the network or defaulted to the same values. The classification experiments indicate that the new model has smaller size and better classification performance compared with conventional classifiers, especially in aspect of generalization performance.

articleTitle: Research on visualization simulation of electromagnetic in complex environments
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: This paper mainly studies methods of how to realize the visual simulation of electromagnetic field influenced by a variety of factors in complex environment. This paper puts forward an implementation plan to fully demonstrate the types, properties and distribution etc. of spatial electromagnetic signal by three-dimensional visualization technology. The author puts emphasis on data processing, radar modeling and visualization methods, furthermore, gives the simulation results of electromagnetic field in different conditions.

articleTitle: Impact of China's sports information network construction factors
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
