abstract: In order to construct the national sports information network following the steps of the developed countries, several factors which influence china sports government affairs information network were discussed. Investigation of the influence of China's eastern region and western region, in the sports government affairs information network construction of subjective and objective factors, pointed out these regions in the network construction of the achievements and shortcomings. Reasons were given based on the differences between economic, technical and personnel in the causes of formation. In the end, this paper proposed some improved guidance and advices which was very useful for the network construction.

articleTitle: On base hanging on the bottom of the swing high-orbiting satellites to enhance coverage of the research
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: This paper investigates that the high-orbit satellites enhance coverage area, using high-orbiting satellites of formation flying swing way. Through Formation flying swing of satellite design, and achieve orbit hovering configuration parameters. Simulation examples show that the method of the formation flying swing was proposed successfully enhanced coverage area of the satellite, by increasing the magnitude of the swing and reduced the distance between the satellite to high orbit satellite coverage area enhance the effect.

articleTitle: The construction and development of Remote Virtual Laboratory Based on Virtools
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: The paper demonstrates the characteristics of Remote Virtual laboratory and he Construction and development of Remote Virtual Laboratory Based on Virtools. Take “OA” virtual laboratory for instance and discuss the key technologies of the construction and development of it, putting forward 3Ds Max and Virtools implementation and concrete steps.

articleTitle: An extension approach that supports attribute based access control for WS-BPEL
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Business processes, the next-generation workflows, have attracted considerable interest in recent years. Several XML-based languages have been proposed for specifying and orchestrating business processes. WS-BPEL (Web Services Business Process Execution Language), which is widely used in business process specification, cannot support authorization policies on the execution of activities. In this paper, we propose an approach that extends WS-BPEL with ABAC (Attribute Based Access Control) model to satisfy the access control requirements of business processes. We introduce an access control framework for Web services in business processes, and through integrating ABAC and WS-BPEL, we make it possible to make access control policies for business processes.

articleTitle: Prediction on turbine supercharger speed of diesel engines based on projection pursuit regression
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: In the plateau environment with low pressure, turbine supercharger speed is an important parameter to supervise working condition of diesel engines. In view of the problems of installation difficulty and low measurement accuracy in measurement of turbine supercharger speed in vehicles, this paper sets up a projection pursuit regression (PPR) model to predict turbine supercharger speed. The calculation result indicates that the fitting effect of this model is obviously superior to that of any other regression models, which has great significance to prediction on turbine supercharger speed of diesel engines in a low pressure environment.

articleTitle: DetSF: A deterministic scheduling framework
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Deterministic scheduling is widely used in bug detection, record & replay and deterministic execution systems which all aim to improve the reliability of multithreaded programs. This paper designs and implements a deterministic scheduling framework (DetSF) to support fast development of various deterministic scheduling systems. Based on binary instrumentation, DetSF could control the scheduling (threads' running order) of multi-threaded programs both in fine and coarse granularities. DetSF provides an efficient and easy-to-use interface for upper tools to control the scheduling of multithreaded programs. To better analyze the performance of deterministic scheduling systems, DetSF also provides a profiling subsystem to dynamically collect runtime information. DetSF could be used in quick simulation and comparing of different deterministic execution algorithms. By enforcing a certain scheduling policy, DetSF could also be applied to implement a bug detector which can manifest concurrency bugs. We demonstrate the practicality of DetSF by implementing two existing deterministic algorithms on it. With the support of our framework, it only needs to add a bit line of codes to implement the two algorithms.

articleTitle: The application of the process control in the construction of the logistics center
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: The construction of the logistics center is very important. To consider this question, we put forward a new idea on how to determine the capacity of the logistics center. Through the discussion of the input flow and the output flow, we give the method to determine the capacity of the logistics center in two different cases: goods easy to spoilage and not easy to spoilage. As an illustration, we give an example.

articleTitle: A 24GHz microstrip array antenna
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: A novel 24GHz microstrip array antenna with 168 rectangular resonators is presented. Compared with the traditional 18×14 microstrip elements array, 84 elements may be reduced with same performance. The feeding network with Dolph-Chebyshev distribution is used for low side lob, and the side lobe of microstrip array antenna is less than -17 dB. The proposal design is confirmed by both simulation and measured results.

articleTitle: A dynamic load balancing method for parallel rendering and physical simulation system based sort-first architecture
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Load balancing is a key technology in parallel computation which determines the performance and scalability of parallel rendering system. Generally, only the balancing of rendering load is considered for previous load balancing methods, and the balancing of physical simulation load in the system is rarely considered. This paper presents a dynamic load balancing strategy which is based on screen partition of dual division and three-dimensional space division, realizing the load balancing of rendering load and physical simulation load in the parallel system.

articleTitle: Model of flood control operation of reservoir based on particle swarm optimization algorithm and its application
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Because the generation type of the traditional interactive flood dispatching program has some defects, a conditional random automatic generation is put forward, and it operate optimal flood dispatching model which is based on PSO algorithm. It deals with boundary conditions and other inequality constraints with penalty function method. The results of the application show that improved PSO algorithm has faster computed speed and more rationale results than the conventional dynamic programming, and it is an effective way of optimal flood-control operation in river basin.

articleTitle: The compound stochastic control on the ship lateral motion
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: The Combined anti-roll device with passively controlled anti-rolling tank and course rudder, and the ship lateral motion modeling method using the compound stochastic control are proposed in the paper. On one hand, using Kalman filter in to come out interaction estimate and adopt to pen-loop compensation controls, which carrys on compensating to the wave interference; On the other hand, using the stochastic LQG Suboptimal Control to carry on the control toward the ships horizontal carriage. Imitate true result express, this kind of compound control a method to have good effect, more commendable in the engineering the application.

articleTitle: History-based constraints for dynamic separation-of-duty policies in usage control
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Separation of Duty (SoD) is a widely used security principle to help prevent frauds in a business process. Recently presented usage control (VeON) has been considered as the next generation access control model. However, as a related and fundamental problem, the research of SoD policy in VeON has not been explored. In this paper, we give a formal definition of dynamic SoD (DSoD) policies, and show that checking whether a VeONA state satisfies a given DSoD policy is a coNP-complete problem, only two special cases can be checked in polynomial time. We propose the history-based constraints for enforcing DSoD policies in usage control. The key idea is to record each permission access request, and use these histories to make the decision when a new permission request is generated. This approach poses and answers fundamental questions related to enable the use of constraints to support SoD policies in VeON.

articleTitle: Research on dynamic resource allocation strategy for sharing bandwidth in multilink network based on delay trend control
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Aiming at the problem of bandwidth resource control mechanism in multilink broadband network environment, the calculation method of data transmission delay is analyzed, a model of sharing bandwidth resource dynamic allocation in multilink is designed, the relationship of bandwidth resource allocation and data transmission delay is researched, a method of dynamic resource allocation strategy for sharing bandwidth in multilink network based on delay trend control is presented, and the resource allocation is also quantified. The simulation experiments show that the method can effectively improve the bandwidth utilization rate and reduce the data transmission delay.

articleTitle: Robust stability of uncertain systems with two time-varying delay components
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: This paper is concerned with the problem of robust stability of linear uncertain systems with two additive time-varying delay components. By constructing new Lyapunov-Krasovskii functionals, some improved sufficient stability criteria are developed using the Finsler's Lemma and Jensen's inequality. The maximum upper bound on the delay can be obtained by solving a set of linear matrix inequalities. Numerical examples are given to show the effectiveness and less conservativeness of the proposed methods.

articleTitle: WNN optimization design based on Artificial Fish-Swarm Algorithm
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: The problem such as parameters initialization and network structure determination is collectively referred to as the WNN optimization design. Aiming at the effect on the performance of WNN, an optimization design algorithm, which is based on Artificial Fish-Swarm Algorithm(AFSA), is proposed. The AFSA can synchronously determine the initial values of parameters and hidden layer nodes number in search space. The simulation results show it is an effective algorithm, which not only has higher accuracy and faster convergence rate but also can avoid the blindness of the WNN optimization design.

articleTitle: The analyses of an improved 2-order Chebyshev chaotic sequence
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: This paper proposes a new method to obtain an improved 2-order Chebyshev chaotic sequence, along with the theoretical analysis and the simulation experiments with the sequence. Compared with m sequence in the balance property and the run-length property, the sequence maintains good performance. The findings of theoretical analysis and the experiments show that the improved sequence is better than m sequence application in spread spectrum communication system.

articleTitle: A three-level verification approach on Wireless Communication Controller System
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Wireless Communication Controller System is an industrial communication system that controls multiple categories of radios to communicate with remote systems. Due to high cost and great uncertainty in this wireless system test, we present our work in terms of formally modeling, verifying and improving the system. To deal with the complexity of concurrent system verification, we propose a three-level verification method, from the lowest function view to secondary component view and then to the highest system view. By SPIN model checker, we have discovered some deadlock scenarios and boundary-value errors in the system. After being corrected, the system demonstrates well behaviors in the next step of verification.

articleTitle: Dynamic analysis of an SEIS model with bilinear incidence rate
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: This paper investigates an SEIS model with bilinear incidence rate. By means of Lyapunov function theorem, we proved the global asymptotical stable results of the disease-free equilibrium and the endemic equilibrium. In addition, we also study the phenomena of Hopf bifurcation and limit cycle of the systems with the numerical simulations.

articleTitle: Study of computer application to college English test in China
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: The study aims to investigate computer use in China's college English test (CET). By illustrating the development of computerized language testing, we discuss how computer technology is realized in CET. Then, by analyzing current situation of computer use in CET, we explore the aspects and extent to which computer technology is used. Lastly, we probe the problems arising from Internet-based CET and suggest the corresponding solutions, therefore, providing some insights for the computer application to China's language testing.

articleTitle: Symmetric raised cosine keying modulation and performance analysis
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: A new binary digital modulation method is proposed, this is symmetric raised cosine keying (SRCK) modulation method. The temporal expressions of the SRCK modulated sample waveforms are deduced, and the PSD of the SRCK modulated signals are simulated and analyse. Compare with MSK modulated signals on the bandwidth efficiency and communication performance, the SRCK modulated signals have the advantages about high energy concentration, high bandwidth efficiency and good resistance to amplitude fading. The SRCK modulation method provides a way for next generation high efficiency modulaion communication system.

articleTitle: The study on computer network security and precaution
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: With the coming of the information age, all kinds of high-techniques, such as computer science and network techniques are widely used in different fields of the society which not only have made great economic and social benefits, but also have promoted the rapid development in culture and techniques. While the openness and flexibility of computer network brought us a lot of benefit both in life and in work, it also caused a series of information security problems which put our life into danger. The thesis aims to analyze the nature of computer network security and the major factors that influence the network security, probe the existing problems and possible threats of the network system and work out an effective security precaution strategy. The analysis and strategy are quite useful for establish a safe, efficient and convenient network environment. Besides, they can strengthen the awareness of safety operation and improve the actual application. So they are of great value both in theory and practice.

articleTitle: The research on financial chaos control based on dynamic theory
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: With the outbreak of the global financial crisis, the stability of financial system has become a hot topic. This paper has studied financial stability through model analysis and numerical simulations. We find that the stability of financial system is up to parameters in the system, when the parameters affecting stability of financial system are beyond its stable reach, the financial system will pass through double periodicity to chaos.

articleTitle: Testing technology of airscrew base on the asynchronous motor
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: In view of the problem that the testing accuracy and efficiency about electric driving of airscrew testing, the constitute and key technique was analyzed and discussed of airscrew electric propulsion system, the author puts forward some proposals describes and the design idea, the test system was designed, which provide effective research route and foundation for propulsion systems validate.

articleTitle: The translational hull of completely ℐ̃-simple semigroups
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: The structure of translational hull of completely ℐ̃-simple semigroups is considered. The main result in this paper not only generalizes a structure theorem of translational hulls for completely simple semigroups but also strengthens some structure theorems of translational hull for completely ℐ*-simple semigroups.

articleTitle: Remote sensing image fusion method based on generalized IHS transform
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: A fusion processing of remote sensing image data is carried out based on IHS principle, by using MATLAB experiment tool, in order to resolve the problem which can not give consideration to both the spatial resolution and spectral information in remote sensing. This paper proposes a fusion method by combining generalized intensity-hue-saturation (GIHS) transformation and maximum a posteriori (MAP) analysis in order to improve the fusion quality of multispectral (MS) and panchromatic (Pan) images from a new type of remote sensing platforms. The proposed method is compared with the GIHS fusion method, the wavelet transform (WT) fusion method, and the combined WT-GIHS fusion method. The experimental results show that the proposed method can achieve better fusion result than exiting fusion methods.

articleTitle: A 5-stage pipelined embedded processor with optimized handling exception
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: This paper presents the design and implementation of a embedded processor, xCore_AHB, featuring precise interrupt and exception, which is compatible with ARMv4 architecture. The precise exception mechanism of this design provides not only the quick entrance of the interrupt handle programs but also the interrupt handle programs with the right return address by an additional program counter in write back stage of the pipeline and its support circuits. The proposed exception controller saves about 30% area compared with the traditional exception controller. The proposed design has been implemented with the 0.18um IP6M CMOS process of SMIC. The chip operates 1.2DMIPS at a frequency of 100MHz with 33mW power dissipation.

articleTitle: An efficient real-time event detection approach based on temporal-spatial correlations in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs) have developed rapidly for recent years, and have been widely used in various applications. But sensor nodes are vulnerable to noises to yield errors for their limited power and energy. In this paper, an efficient real-time event detection approach based on temporal-spatial correlations of sensing data is proposed. The method can eliminate the influence of errors by temporal linear compare and spatial vertical compare to the accuracy of query results, at the same time, it can satisfy real time requirements issued by the users. Experimental results validate that this approach can improve the precision and reliability of event detection.

articleTitle: Video semantic authentication method based on UCL
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: In the light of semantic security issue in H.264 video, a strategy of video semantic authentication method based on UCL (Uniform Content Locator) is proposed. In this strategy, UCL information are embedded as semantic watermarks into the medium frequency range of DCT coefficients of I frames and semantic feature information are embedded into motion vectors of P frames. The strategy is implemented by incorporating a UCL-based watermarking method. Experimental results show that this method can effectively embed and protect semantic information under a variety of attacks and it also has little effect on video code rate change and content distortion.

articleTitle: Parameter design and performance study on election campaign optimization algorithm
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: The on-line performance and off-line performance are provided to evaluate the performances of Election Campaign Optimization (ECO) algorithm used in functions optimization. The relatively between the selected parameters of ECO and the algorithm performance is analyzed by researching the numerical optimal problem of standard test functions. It is expected to observe the changes of the responses by changing the parameters of ECO so as to get some reference basis of selected parameters. Numerical optimal experimental results of standard test functions show that on-line performance and off-line performance are improved by variation of parameters.

articleTitle: Multi-purpose operation optimization of cascade hydroelectric power stations based on improved accelerating genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: In this study, improved accelerating genetic algorithm was applied in the mid-and-long term operation optimization of cascade hydroelectric power stations. A mid-and-long term operation optimization model was constructed with the target functions being the maximization of cascade power capacity and probability of power generation. Combined with simulated annealing thinking, penalty factor was established to turn the two targets into an integrated one. With this algorithm, local searching method was pitched into accelerating genetic algorithm to improve the global optimization ability of this algorithm, and the possibility of curse of dimensionality when applying dynamic planning in the solving of complex optimization problems can be minimized. It was shown by the calculation results that schedule schemes with high timeliness, even distribution and good convergence can be obtained with this algorithm. Through coupling analysis of the relationship between scheduling targets, scientific guide can be provided for the multi-objective scheduling of cascade hydroelectric power station.

articleTitle: Research on the integration and query optimization for the distributed heterogeneous database
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Heterogeneous database query optimization should study not only the node database integrated in different database, but also to solve the strategy problem which the data query optimization. In this paper, it studied integration among the node database in the distributed heterogeneous database system and the query strategy for the data in heterogeneous databases. It was put forward the database of integration solutions based on Hibernate and query optimization strategy that used the tiny user inquires the response time, and for this scheme design in this concrete solution.

Author Keywords: the tiny response time of user querye

articleTitle: A modified RLS algorithm for identification of power amplifier nonlinear model
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Identifying accurately the parameters of power amplifier (PA) nonlinear model is essential in modeling and predistortion of PA. RLS (Recursive Least Square) is a common used algorithm in parameter identification. The proposed algorithm modifies the cost function of the conventional RLS by multiplying a weighting function. The simulation results verify that the modified algorithm has better normalized mean square error (NMSE) performance than the conventional RLS.

articleTitle: An improved algorithm of news video caption detection and recognition
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: News video captions have an important role in video analysis and retrieval. First, the article analyzed the algorithm of news video caption detection, then, analyzed the algorithm of the video subtitle processing based on the analysis of wavelet transform, consequently, analyzed the algorithm of the caption segmentation on the basis of the analysis of the line projection and the column projection. At last, the article realized the news video caption recognition using a similarity measure formula. Experiment showed that the algorithm can effectively segment the video caption and recognized the caption efficiency, which can satisfy the need of video analysis and retrieval.

articleTitle: A Web knowledge service system based on memory space
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Knowledge has become one of the most important resources of any organization, and the effective management and utilization of knowledge is a key factor for increasing the competitiveness of a company. Organizational memory is crucial to the accumulation of the organizational knowledge and the training of the staff. This paper studies how to achieve an effective knowledge management in the network environment. We introduce the organizational memory concept to the construction of an organizational knowledge management system and design a Web knowledge service system architecture based on memory space. We further design the system components in detail, including the knowledge portal and knowledge services, the composition and operation model of the memory space, the organization and storage of knowledge. An application of the system design shows the effectiveness of the system.

articleTitle: Specification and enforcement of separation-of-duty policies in role-base access control
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Separation-of-duty (SoD) is widely considered to be a fundamental principle to role based access control (RBAC) models and systems should adhere. In this paper, we formulate and study the fundamental problem of SoD policies in the context of RBAC systems. We give a set-based specification of SoD policies and the safety checking problem for SoD policies in the context of RBAC. We study the problem of determining whether a SoD policy is enforceable, and show that directly enforcing SoD policies in RBAC is intractable (coNP-complete). Moreover, indirectly enforcing SoD policies by using mutually exclusive role constraints is also intractable (NP-hard). Therefore, we reduce the safety checking problem for SoD to SAT4J problem which can be solved using available SAT solvers. The experiments show the validity and effectively of the SAT approach.

articleTitle: Symmetry extension DFT-based channel estimation for LTE downlink
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: This paper investigates the channel estimation methods of LS, MMSE, DFT and DCT for LTE downlink in Rayleigh fading environments. From this, we propose symmetry extension DFT-based channel estimation algorithm which can mitigate the aliasing error and high-frequency distortion of the discrete Fourier transform (DFT)-based channel estimation. Furthermore, symmetry extension DFT-based channel estimation algorithm has the advantages of utilizing mature FFT algorithm on IC, avoiding the additional IC required for the DCT implementation. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm can improve the MSE performance compared with conventional DFT-based channel estimation.

articleTitle: Research on feature matching algorithm based on three-dimensional information acquisition
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Image feature matching in three-dimensional information acquisition technology is an important aspect of machine vision, in order to achieve the real-time and matching robustness requirement, an image registration method based on SURF algorithm is proposed. First construct Hessian matrix based on box-type filter, use SURF algorithm to calculate the information of feature points, then decompose characteristics of feature points and match feature points. Experimental results show that the matching speed of SURF algorithm is 4 times as fast as the SIFT algorithm, greatly improves the real-time and robustness.

articleTitle: An improved scale invariant feature transform algorithm based on rounded projection
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: The scale-invariant feature transform algorithm proposed by Lowe has a low efficiency which can not meet the need of real-time. The algorithm based on rounded projection proposed in our paper applies Fast Fourier Transform algorithm (FFT) on the projection local area to compute the first harmonic components which are used to prescreen the feature points that extracted by SIFT algorithm. We carry on the image to match according to the prescreened feature points to calculate the local area descriptors. The experiments show that new algorithm has a less number of feature points than the original, so it improves the efficiency and has a better performance.

articleTitle: A refined quadtree-based automatic classification method for remote sensing image
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: In pixel-based remote sensing image classification, the long processing time limits application of classification. Image segmentation is adopted to accelerate the classification speed. Image segmentation is a procedure of dividing an image into separated homogenous regions. These regions are considered as objects to be classified. A refined quadtree-based segmentation algorithm is proposed in the paper. The windowed aggregation method is designed to solve the problem of over-segmentation, which occurs in quadtree-based segmentation. A spot 5 remote sensing image in Qingdao was selected as the test image. Three experiments were implemented on the test image: the first is pixel-based classification; the second is quadtree-based classification; the third is refined quadtree-based classification. The pixel-based classification obtains the highest accuracy while takes more time. The refined quadtree-based classification is superior to quadtree-based classification in time consumed and accuracy.

articleTitle: A new mathematical modeling method based on space geometry theory
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Regression analysis is a kind of mathematical modeling approach to find the relation which hidden in variables through experiment and observation. This method can describe a perfect relation in many problems usually. But the amount of computation is high because we must use a complexity mathematical expression when wanted to get a satisfying result. This paper analyzes mathematical behavior of linear regression in high dimensional space, and finds the relation between variables and their functions with dependent variables in measurement space. Experiment proved the approach is well-defined, low computation complexity and effective.

articleTitle: Novel gene finding through BLAST search. Phylogenitic analysis through MEGA
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: This article explains how I found a novel gene by using BLAST online search tool. How to get benefit from existing tools of Bioinformatics. This paper also shows the importance of Computer Science tools and methods in the field of Bioinformatics. An unknown DNA sequence or Novel gene in any Genomic Database can be discovered and annotated through this Bioinformatics tool. MSA and Phylogenetic analysis of this Novel EST and its homologous Genes and related synthesized Proteins is the main focus of this paper. This work explains the overall methodology how to find a novel Gene through existing and already implemented Bioinformatics tools.

articleTitle: Research and implementation of a virtual joypad based on Android
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Nowadays, smartphones are widely attracted, due to their capability of making the mobile phone no longer only a device providing the calling service, but also an intelligent pocket personal computer. By installing additional software on the phone, the control process can be made ubiquitous and wireless. Over these years, it is hard to deny that touch based gaming has really come a long way, with which, gamers everywhere are given new avenues as regards to the enjoyment of their beloved hobby. In this paper, we created a virtual joypad for the Android-power mobile phone users to play desktop PC games, as well as a virtual joypad server on windows platform to receive messages from Android client and translate into what games can recognize. The testing result shows our virtual joypad is offering us a novel and unforgettable playing experience.

articleTitle: A method for modeling and analyzing the security attributes of service-oriented software system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: In Service Oriented Architecture (SOA), software is implemented through a series of services and the business processes composed of services which introduce potential security problems. These security problems appeared in SOA software applications usually lead information systems and their business processes to risks. Similar to traditional quality of service (QoS) attributes such as reliability and robustness, security is one of the most important attributes of software system. In this paper, the method for modeling and analyzing the security attributes of SOA software system is investigated. Firstly, the service oriented computing model for security analysis is constructed, which characterizes service computing paradigm and related security attributes, and can be used for establishing service oriented software security metric system. Secondly, the service attack path is analyzed based upon the service oriented computing model. Finally, the effectiveness of the model and the analysis method is validated through case studies.

articleTitle: The model of extracting the height of buildings by shadow in image
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Recently there are many models which make the usage of buildings' shadows to calculate its height, however, they don't care for the universal demand and the method of using coordinates of spatial points is rare. Therefore a comprehensive analysis puts forward, referring how to utilize a single high resolution satellite image to extract construction's height, and models which involve spatial coordinate are provided.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of underwater plasma intense acoustic focusing sound field
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Underwater plasma intense acoustic focusing sound field modeling and simulation computation has the important guiding significance regarding to the design and evaluation of underwater plasma discharge system. In this paper, we adopts Euler equation as underwater plasma intense acoustic focusing sound filed distribution model, and solve the equation by unwind WENO scheme. The intense pulsed acoustic wave propagation and the focusing sound field distribution is analyzed by simulation, and further verified by some related experiments. Comparing the simulation and the experiment result, a good matching can be found. It shows that the simulation model is reliability and effectiveness in the studying of underwater focusing shockwave sound field.

articleTitle: Crossing distribution of circuit wires between two regions using indexed binary search tree
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: In the problem of crossing distribution of circuit wires between two regions, the current algorithms of using either linear list or dynamic programming have the complexity of O(n<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>). In order to reduce the complexity of the existing algorithms, a more efficient algorithm of using indexed binary search tree is introduced in this paper. The effectiveness of the algorithm with a time consuming complexity of O(nlogn) is illustrated through the theoretical analysis and by demonstrating the experiment results of corresponding C++ program.

articleTitle: Test SQL injection vulnerabilities in web applications based on structure matching
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: SQL injection, known as a popular attack against web applications, has become a serious security risk. However, traditional penetration test methods are insufficient to test SQL injection vulnerabilities (SQLIVs) in web applications. This paper presents a new test method called SMART, which automatically tests SQLIVs in web applications. SMART analyzes the SQL queries generated by web applications and uses a structure matching validation mechanism to determine whether SQLIVs exist. Comprehensive experiments show that SMART is effective in finding SQLIVs. Testing the web applications with SMART, the security against SQL injection can be greatly improved.

articleTitle: Design of cosine-modulated filter banks with large number of channels based on FRM technique
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Applications that using cosine-modulated filter banks (CMFB) with large number of channels may encounter the design of high order prototype filter (PF), which often makes the direct-form design method fail due to the impractical arithmetical complexity. An efficient indirect-form design approach of the PF is proposed based on frequency response masking (FRM) technique. First, the PF is substituted by various subfilters of the narrow band FRM. Then an iterative second-order cone-programming (SOCP) based scheme like [1] is used to solve the nonconvex optimization problem. An improved FRM based implementation structure is also presented for complex-exponential modulated filter banks (CEMFB). Numerical results indicate the efficiency of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A new ad hoc group key agreement scheme
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: For the characteristics of ad hoc networks, group key management analysis of the current research results and problems, group key management protocol based on NTRU public key cryptosystem was proposed. Trusted center offline to generate key and other initialization parameters for each member of the group. In the group key agreement process useing the NTUR digital signature to realize the user and the private key information authentication. The correctness and security of the protocol are proof‥ In satisfies ad hoc network security conditions, The agreement is simple in design and requires limited calculation and limited storage space etc benefits.

articleTitle: STM protocol: Signaling transmission and spectrum sensor are jointed in cognitive radio networks
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Cognitive radio networks(CRNs) is a framework to combine every distributing secondary user together by one protocol approach that makes primary users and secondary users work in order. In traditional CRNs technology, secondary users should sense all frequencies periodically by spectrum sensor while it is communicating. But it presents one problem that secondary users will stop to sense all frequencies if primary users appear on the band, while the communication delay depends on the number of users. In this letter, we propose a new CRNs protocol STM based mesh-type network that senses the spectrum by combing tradeoff among secondary users with traditional spectrum sensor.

articleTitle: Research and application of an extended role-based access control
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Role-based access control (RBAC) model is widely used at the moment. Aiming at the executive order of role and time limit of permissions on RBAC96, this paper puts forward an extended role-based access control model (RBAC-TS).The new model details the access control and adds the concepts of Time-Control and Sequence-Control, based on the former RBAC model. The paper gives the theoretical model, and the model has been applied in specific systems.

articleTitle: An extension mechanism and its application to educational software for real-time control experiment
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: When designing the architecture and function of software, researchers often encounter the demand to enhance the extensibility of the software. To realize flexible extensibility, this paper presents an extension mechanism to enhance the extensibility from three aspects: architecture, function and interface. The flexible architecture is achieved by using Rich Client Platform (RCP) platform which has a micro-kernel. The function dynamic adding ability is achieved by using the plug-in mechanism. Customized extension of function interface is achieved by using the scripting technology. The proposed extension mechanism is applied in the EasyControl software which is designed for real-time control education. The experiment shows that the proposed mechanism can effectively improve the extensibility of the software.

articleTitle: Robust dissipative control for discrete-time uncertain singular systems with interval time-varying state and input delays
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: The dissipative analysis and control synthesis for uncertain singular systems with interval time-varying state and input delays are investigated in this paper. The parametric uncertainty in this paper is assumed to be norm bounded. A sufficient condition, in the form of linear matrix inequality (LMI) with nonlinear constraints, on the existence of robust dissipative controller is established based on the Lyapunov stability theory. In order to solve the nonlinear problem, Cone Complementarity Linearization (CCL) is offered.

articleTitle: Analysis and design of persistent layer in object-oriented application program based on ORM
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: This thesis focuses on the method of directly constructing relational database schema with the use of object-oriented analysis results and Object/Relation Mapping tools. Compared to the traditional entity relation diagram, this kind of method is much more suitable for the object-oriented analysis and design, and it has reduced many intermediate links and. Consequently it proves to be more real-time and efficient.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of quality tracking system based on cloud computing
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Because the lack of a unified general quality tracking system for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) at present, this paper designs and implements a quality tracking service system based on cloud computing, in order to improve SMEs's ability of the monitoring, timely discovering and solving the problem. In the system, the cloud computing technology is used to solve the problem of data storage and management. The system is developed by using the service-oriented architecture, and making the application of the system as a service, so that it is convenient for spreading and applying. Practice proved it can reduce the massive operation and save maintenance costs, at the same time greatly improve the efficiency and reliability of the system.

articleTitle: Analysis of an optical packet switch with limited wavelength converters and shared buffers
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: This paper focuses on the performance of an optical packet switch with limited range wavelength converters and shared fiber delay lines. In order to deal with the constraints of fiber delay line contention and limited wavelength conversion, a control algorithm is proposed. Performance of the considered switch is evaluated by means of simulation experiments. Packet loss rate versus the number of fiber delay lines, the wavelength conversion range, and the traffic load are analyzed in detailed.

articleTitle: Design of intra prediction module in H.264 and AVS dual modes video decoder chip
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: This paper introduces the structure of intra prediction module, which has been implemented with Verilog hardware language, in H.264 and AVS dual modes video decoder chip. Firstly, the video coding standards and their principle are introduced. Then a highly efficient hardware architecture is given based on the analysis of intra prediction algorithm in H.264 and AVS. This design reuses some modules according to the common of H.264 and AVS in architecture and algorithm, in particular the PE processing unit. The parallel pipeline and memory controller are also adopted to enhance the decoding efficiency. Finally, the design passes the FPGA verification, which its results of simulation and synthesis show that the timing and area requirements of chip design are both satisfied.

articleTitle: MEMS based Human-Machine Interaction System for virtual touring
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: To obtain a kind of cheap, convenient and user-friendly virtual reality interaction system, the Human-Machine Interaction System based on Micro Electronic Mechanical Sensor (MEMS), LM3S1138 embedded Micro Control Unit (MCU) and Vega modeling software for virtual touring is introduced in this paper. Two MEMS including a magnetic sensor and an accelerate sensor are utilized to calculate the state variable of the joystick. Based on the measurements of two sensors the state variable consists of azimuth and inclination are computed which can uniquely determine the state of joystick in spherical coordinates. The system, firstly, record the initial state of joystick. Then by comparing the variation between initial state and current state, action command changing the viewpoint in the virtual world are generated. Finally, in Vega established virtual world theoretical command boundary and measured command boundary are compared proving the feasibility of this system in practice.

articleTitle: Research on symbol fusion in the process of situation visualization
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Along to the durative increase of the battlefield situation information, the graphically visualize of which becomes a more and more complicated problem. How to plot the operational symbols on the basic geographical map suitably, clearly and completely deserves more consideration. This article bases on the presentation of huge battlefield information, make a specific research on fusing the operational symbols automatically in different echelon, different task, and different scale, which includes the deployment, aggregation, splitting and the transformation from point symbol to line or area, analyses the basic concepts of symbol fusion and the main problems when using symbols to present the situation. At last, we suggest specific methods of symbol fusion.

articleTitle: Indexed principal processes of concurrent cryptographic protocols
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: In this paper, we present an indexed principal process language and apply it to modeling for concurrent cryptographic protocols running in an infinite concurrent manner. The indexed principal process algebra according to CCS language for concurrent computing in cryptographic protocols is adopted as the formal operating semantics of the indexed principal process language. And we introduce a symbolic transition graph and its variant with a binary equivalence relation over topological spaces of the indexed principal processes based on CCS with infinite assignments, which is used to express one cryptographic protocol being independent of other cryptographic protocol or of its different run in an infinite concurrent manner. The result applies to partition the cryptographic protocol and its multi-runs over topological spaces of its conversation domain to reduce computational complexities to prove security attributes of cryptographic protocols running in an infinite concurrent manner.

articleTitle: P2i-torus: A hybrid artchitecutre for direct interconnection
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Direct networks are the counterparts of indirect networks like multistage interconnect networks which rooted in the telecommunication and parallel computing. Direct networks are getting more and more promising in latest data center networking research. Torus is one of the most popular direct networks and it is a common practice in supercomputers and some core routers. In this paper we proposed a novel hybrid architecture which is formed by adding extra channels to a classic torus network. The channels are added in a fashion that has been proved to be asymptotical minimal for load-balancing, besides, we devised the corresponding load-balancing routing scheme for this hybrid architecture. Static network characteristics is analyzed and compared with other direct networks. Simulation results are provided to show that these express paths improved the network performance in concert to the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Simulation on gas-particle flows in horizontal pipe before dust explosion
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: This paper were to employ gas and particle two phase flow mathematical model, applying in professional fluid dynamics software FLUENT, It is a PISC coupling calculation method for making gas and particle flow research before dust explosion. Experiment had shown which lead to relatively strong dust explosion in a weak shock wave flow and horizontal pipeline under dynamic condition. The calculation results show that, It is weak shock strength of 1.18, airflow velocity range of 28.2-35.3m/s, turbulent energy of the range of 6.69 -14.8 m/s, airflow temperature rise, above 300 of the cases, strong dust explosion is taking place, As particle motion rule shows that it is 1 μm smaller than fine particles at bottom in the pipeline, It is 20 μm greater than particles at upper in the explosion level pipe chamber. It is an aim to investigate dust explosion gas and particle rules and conditions in a horizontal pipeline.

articleTitle: A complex event processing based alarm system for coal mine safety monitoring
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Complex event processing (CEP) is a technology for extracting information that is of interest to users from enormous events, which can be meritorious in either low level data processing or high level enterprise business intelligence. In this paper, we propose a CEP based alarm system for coal mine safety monitoring. We also introduce the framework of the alarm system based on the Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA) whose message exchange mechanism is event-driven by the way of publish/subscribe. In particular, we present the design of a closed-loop alarm disposal process written in BPEL which promotes the transparency and standardization in the coal mine alarm disposal process.

articleTitle: Process-level virtual machine embedded chain mode memory management method
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: This article puts forward an embedded chain mode memory management method and an associated memory data structure based on a process-level virtual machine platform. Compared to conventional dynamic memory management methods, the method disclosed in this article has advantages, for example, it is unnecessary to create chained lists for memory allocation to manage allocated memory blocks or occupy additional system memory units to store the information of the chained list of free blocks. It can effectively solve the problem of compromised system efficiency as a result of searching in the chained list of allocated blocks in the memory reclamation process, and can merge free blocks very conveniently to reduce memory fragments at the same time. Both theoretical analysis result and experimental result demonstrate that this method can effectively improve the dynamic memory management efficiency, and that benefit becomes more apparent as the memory allocation and release becomes more frequently.

articleTitle: Research on constructing virtual video scenes using aesthetic photo retouching
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Aesthetic photo retouching is the process of removing some given targets in a real photo deliberately and producing a complete, natural-looking pseudo-image automatically. The implement of aesthetic photo retouching depends on the proposed image inpainting method, especially the capacity of the restoration of large and thick damaged regions with composite textures. Video is a series of images in the time dimension of evolution, if the designated targets in a video can be removed, the contents of the original video can be changed. The paper presents a novel method of constructing virtual video scenes, which can track the designated target based on histograms match in each video frame, and then remove it using aesthetic photo retouching. The approach provides a potential solution for low-cost creating virtual video scene.

articleTitle: Teaching reform of ASP.NET Programming Design curriculum based on CDIO teaching concept
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Aiming at the traditional teaching defects of ‘ASP.NET Programming Design’, teaching reform is carried out for the curriculum by applying CDIO teaching concept. It introduces the teaching system taking students as the center, ‘learning through doing’, summarizing the reform contents and detailed implementation plan in terms of the teaching organization, teaching methods and the assessment mode of the curriculum.

articleTitle: A particle system for implicit surfaces reconstruction
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: This paper presents a particle system which displays implicit surfaces. First, we find a particle as a seed. Initialize all particle positions through the moving and updating of the seed particle. The cotangent force makes particles repel each other. The reprojection of normal vector constrains particles moving on the surfaces. The particle system can finally reach a stable and balance state. The method is also effective on displaying singularity points. The experiments result show the flexibility and efficiency of the particle system.

articleTitle: Image domain ontology fusion approach using multi-level inference mechanism
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: One of the main challenges in content-based or semantic image retrieval is still to bridge the gap between low-level features and semantic information. In this paper, An approach is presented using integrated multi-level image features in ontology fusion construction by a fusion framework, which based on the latent semantic analysis. The proposed method promotes images ontology fusion efficiently and broadens the application fields of image ontology retrieval system. The relevant experiment shows that this method ameliorates the problem, such as too many redundant data and relations, in the traditional ontology system construction, as well as improves the performance of semantic images retrieval.

articleTitle: Research on technique of software testing based on fault tree analysis
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Software testing is essential to ensure software quality. In order to more effectively improve the efficiency of software testing, fault tree analysis is introduced into software testing. This paper forwards the method on constructing fault tree model and presents a arithmetic on minimum cut sets. The quantitative analysis and qualitative analysis about fault tree model are discussed and the result is used in software testing.

articleTitle: The study on art education reformation based on information technology
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: The appearance of digital, bring huge effect to the traditional art education, also impact the whole education thought and teaching system in our country. Information age request school to raise the art talented man can handle various kinds of new visual language. So reform the traditional teaching style and pay more attention to the crossing relationship of different courses of study, will be the requirement of the high art education and age.

articleTitle: A new analysis of double-dwell serial search and its performance in direct-sequence spread-spectrum systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: The problem of code acquisition in a direct-sequence spread-spectrum(DSSS) system in dense multipath environment is addressed. And the performance improvement of this acquisition has been a difficult issue, because the theoretical analysis is both complex and not accurate enough. In this paper, we propose a mathematical analysis based on the theory of flow graph, which has significantly reduced computation complexity by about 92% and helped to optimize parameters to get a better performance. This method is both systematic and general. Simulation indicates the accuracy and usefulness of this method of analysis.

articleTitle: The contrast on random network coding scheme with routing scheme in wireless network
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Random Network Coding relies on using random codes at nodes for multicast or in cast networks. In random network coding, interior network nodes independently choose random linear mappings from inputs to outputs. The effect of the network is that of a transfer matrix from sources to receivers. To recover symbols at the receivers, we require sufficient degrees of freedom an invertible matrix in the coefficients of all nodes. Receiver nodes can be decoded if they receive as many independent linear combinations as the number of source processes.

articleTitle: A simple and practicable email storage space compression method
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Email servers of large-scale enterprises generally demand large storage space. To mitigate the problem, this paper proposes a simple and practicable email compression method, effectively reducing emails storage space on mail servers. In our method, emails are MIME-decoded first; then attachments are chopped and duplicate attachments removed; finally the attachment files and plain-text email files are compressed. Experiments are performed on two operating email servers, the experiments result indicates that our approach can save more than half of the email storage space.

articleTitle: Image segmentation based on the 2-D maximum entropy value and improved genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Image segmentation, extracting characteristics target from the image for user's requirements, the optimum threshold selection of image segmentation is the key technique. Traditional 2-d maximum entropy image segmentation algorithms use exhaustive way to find the optimal threshold, which is time-consuming, low efficient, and easy to generate the false division. In order to improve the accuracy and efficiency of image segmentation, this paper puts forward a genetic algorithm of 2- d maximum entropy value for image segmentation and makes some improvements in genetic algorithms coding, crossover operator, and mutation operator. Simulation experiments have proved that the new algorithm can greatly shorten the time for optimization, enhance the anti-noise capability in the segmentation process, and improve the efficiency of image segmentation.

articleTitle: Key characteristics extraction method in product concept design
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: To improve the product design quality, a key characteristics (KCs) extraction method in the product concept design was proposed. Firstly, a KCs extraction process in product concept design was established. In order to transform customer requirements into product characteristics, a Human-Product transform method was proposed. Secondly a KCs extraction algorithm was presented. Customer requirements weights were computed by maximizing deviation method. According to customer requirements changing trend, six quadrant plots based on KANO model and ratio of customer satisfaction evaluation was proposed. Finally, a case study illustrates the method feasibility.

articleTitle: Study of collocation in modern Chinese based on corpus methods
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: This paper mainly covers the application of corpus-based approach to the research of collocation in modern Chinese, summarizing and commenting on the basic concepts, formulae, approaches and processes in collocation research. Based on previous studies, this paper raises suggestions on the method of extracting collocates, data arrangement and collocation description, and emphasizes on the use of two methods in study of collocation in modern Chinese: the combination of statistics and manual proofreading and the combination of quantitative research and qualitative research.

articleTitle: Improving deep classification by centroid-based candidate selection strategy
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: According to the Large Scale Hierarchical Classification Workshop of the ECIR 2010 [6], we know that the performance of classification for the large scale hierarchy, such as Open Directory Project (ODP), is still lower. Obviously, we need to improve the performance of hierarchical classification urgently. While a deep classification method [1] was proposed to make the problem tractable, the candidate selection method might be a bottleneck in the deep classification. In this paper, we used a centroid-based classification algorithm as the candidate selection strategy to enhance the deep classification. We conducted experiments with all the Chinese categories on the Open Directory Project. The experimental results show that the proposed method improved the performance of classification through selecting candidate accurately.

articleTitle: Research on Misiurewiz points in Mandelbrot set
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Misiurewiz points and attracting points of the chaotic regions in the Mandelbrot set are located in what we call shrubs. Certain branch points are Misiurewicz points (including all “obvious” branch points in the filaments) and certain terminal points are also Misiurewicz points. Using the method of computer mathematic experiments, The distribution rules of Misiurewiz points in Mandelbrot set generated by the complex mapping z←z2 +c are studied. In this paper, we have focused on the method of solving about Misiurewiz points which located in the Mandelbrot set, and also shows the relationship for Misiurewiz point and Tree trunk of Misiurewiz points with recurrence formula. We have seen that each shrub is made up of infinite chaotic-bands, Including countless Misiurewiz points and periodic buds. it provides a new way on discussing internal structure of Mandelbrot set.

articleTitle: Research on remote education system using semantic web
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Semantic network is the development direction of the world wide web, and it converts the traditional system and the abstract one-dimension table into the associations between semantics through ontology construction, one party for the separation of field data and operating data while the other party to provide new starting point for further researches on field data and business logic reuse. At present the remote education theory put forward the new demand for the management of knowledge base and business logic reuse. We also made progress in the study of the ontology construction, semantic database management and other areas, so it's up to date to achieve a remote education system prototype based on the semantic network. The thesis is about the development of OntoLearning remote education system prototype. OntoLearning is a remote education network system of multilayer based on Web layer, service layer, business application layer, integrated layer and resource layer. It is a main function module covering teaching, file management, objective establishment, and progress management of remote education system, of which the ontology through RDF language briefly describes the semantic relations of teaching management of each party.

articleTitle: Image inpainting based on Radial Basis Function
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: This paper is concerned with Radial Basis Function (RBF) for restoration of damaged images. We introduce the RBF into the image inpainting, and the 2D image inpainting problem is naturally converted to 3D implicit surface reconstruction problem,which has been used successfully. Otherwise, we do some experiments with several kinds of damaged images, the results showed that the use of the RBF method for image processing applications is feasible.

articleTitle: Poisson distribution-based page updating prediction strategy
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: A kind of method predicting the updating period of page is proposed, using the Poisson distribution-based model suggested by Brewington in studying page updating of search engine. This method calculates the expectation of page updating period with Newton iteration method according to historical statistical data then applies it in the subsequent updating strategy, also revises it in the practice in order to approach the real value; its goal is to get a good balance between freshness and resource utilization. Compared to traditional grouping-by-frequency method, algorithm complexity reduces significantly.

articleTitle: The research of CSCW task dividing and distributing mode based on time competed mechanism
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: The paper analyzed diversified methods of CSCW task split in allusion to great workload and many participator and low efficiency in CSCW system. The paper put forward a nuclear structure which is the same with multilayer CSCW system. Then, we put forward a task disaggrega-tire method based on the nuclear structure. The method distributes tasks in CSCW system again in real time by introducing time competed mechanism into Cscw system. We can make the efficiency of CSCW system to attain holistic optimization and quicken the time schedule of task accomplished by the method.

articleTitle: A disk performance optimizing algorithm by adjusting the native command queue based on rotational position
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: The improvement of disk access scheduling policies was one of important means to raise disk access performance. Serial ATA storage equipment couldn't meet network access and service's time-constrained characteristics which scheduled disk access in native command queue based on rotational position ordering (RPO). According to access's the latest deadline time, deadline sensitive and first (DSF) classified storage access into various service queue and schedule, which optimized the embedded scheduling policy. The emulation results had proved it valid to meet the storage access's requirements.

articleTitle: An improved array pattern synthesis algorithm based on Chebyshev polynomial
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Chebyshev polynomial is an important kind of equations of mathematical physics and has been used for the pattern synthesis of antenna array successfully. However, calculation difficulty exists in the calculation of these equations. In this paper, an improved pattern synthesis algorithm based on Chebyshev polynomial is proposed. The proposed algorithm release the difficulty in calculating Chebyshev polynomial. The simulation of the new algorithm is provided and the effectiveness of the new algorithm is verified.

articleTitle: Case similarity measure research for CBR-based public health emergency decision
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Recent years, the frequent occurrence of public health emergency incident in China has caused great loss to economy and severe impact to peoples' lives. The public health emergency decision is an unstructured and non-programmed decision under high pressure, and this has brought great difficulties to public health department. In this paper the case-based reasoning (CBR), a artificial intelligence technology will be introduced to public health emergency decision field and a new similarity measure method for public health case is presented. This method can calculate the similarity of two cases composed of different types of feature values easily which can hardly be achieved by conventional K-NN (k nearest neighbor) method.

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis for wireless sensor network based on genetic-support vector machine
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: It is well-known that the correct diagnosis for wireless sensor network can avoid the paralysis of entire systems. Here, fault diagnosis for wireless sensor network based on genetic-support vector machine is presented in the paper. In SVM, inappropriate training parameters can lead to over-fitting or under-fitting. Thus, genetic algorithm is used to select the appropriate training parameters of support vector machine. Genetic algorithm is a kind of evolutionary computing algorithm, which has strong global search ability. In the experiments, 60 state samples of wireless sensor network are employed to study the diagnosis ability of genetic-support vector machine. The experimental results show that the diagnosis accuracy of the genetic-support vector machine model is higher than that of the support vector machine model.

articleTitle: Research on optimal computing model based on public crisis management
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: With domestic and international frequent public crisis occurring, public crisis management has become a hot academic research. The ability of crisis management capabilities of public crisis management sector and scientific evaluation system design is often affected by many complex factors. An appropriate computational model and the analysis system will be able to achieve the goals of ensuring social security. The optimal computing model of a crisis management is an effective way by the introduction of the basic principles of analytic hierarchy process.

articleTitle: A grid resource matching algorithm
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Resource matching is one of the core functions of the grid resource management. Currently, the resource matching algorithm is mainly divided into two categories: the performance indicated matching algorithm and the cost indicated matching algorithm. This paper use correlation matrix designed a performance and cost constrained resource matching algorithm, which based on weighted Euclidean distance. The matlab simulation results show that the algorithm can effectively find the matched resource out in the network environment.

articleTitle: Latency aware routing mechanism to maximize the life time of MANETs
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Mobile ad hoc networks (MANETs), due their inherent resource constraints and other limitations has prompted the researchers to device energy and bandwidth efficient transmission techniques and protocols. This objective has confronted scientists with the conflicting requirements of energy efficiency and latency. Most of the well known energy efficient protocols like ad hoc on demand distance vector (AODV) protocol and dynamic source routing (DSR) protocol although provide solution for the efficient utilization of the battery power of network nodes but on the other hand, end to end transmission delays are not catered properly. In this paper we proposed a novel cross layer approach to mitigate the latency issues inherently present in the AODV at the same time maintaining the efficient use of battery power. We used received Log-Likelihood ratios (LLR) at each node as the decisive parameter whether or not to participate in the transmission. Hence the nodes deciding against taking part in transmission save lot of energy. The proposed LLR based approach adapts itself according to the nature of traffic. If there is real time traffic, the nodes operate at high transmission power and in case of non real time traffic the transmission power is low. We have applied these modifications in the AODV and the resulting scenario has been simulated with the NS2. Simulation results proved that our scheme conforms to the standards of real time traffic as well as maintain the same energy efficiency.

Author Keywords: ad hoc on demand distance vector routing protocol

articleTitle: Design and implementation of Radio Interface layer in Android video telephone system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: RIL (Radio Interface layer) is a middle layer between applications and wireless module of the protocol stack, it is achieved differently in a variety of mobile platforms, but basically completes the same function which provides voice services, SMS services, data services and so on. In the Android system, as a new wireless communication business, the implementation of video telephone is more complex compared with normal voice. It needs to modify and expand towards RIL layer. This article will focus on the specific design and implementation of RIL module to illustrate.
