articleTitle: Neural network-based nonlinear prediction of reinsurance demand of the Chinese property insurance industry
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Based on the analysis of reinsurance demand and China' s economic environment, the paper establishes the BP Neural Network Model to predict analysis of Reinsurance Demand and its Determinants of the P. R. China' s Property Insurance Industry by using data covering the period from 1997 to 2010. This method enables us to reduce the original 14 input variables to one variable. The results indicate that the BP neural network can achieve higher precision and its forecasting effect is better than other model.

articleTitle: The effect of reliability on LCC and management information system design
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: According to the effect analysis of reliability on life cycle cost (LCC), the model of reliability's effect on equipment's LCC is established. This model is used for LCC optimization and minimizes LCC, under the condition that reliability, maintainability and supportability are all available. With background of the LCC management theory based on reliability and maintainability theory, in combination with the studies on basic attributes of equipment and the cost management theory at home and abroad, we developed high practicability management decision system on equipment LCC scientific analysis. This study provides the scientific basis for scientific and effective LCC management.

articleTitle: Verifiable re-encryption Scheme in BitTorrent-like cipherblock exchange protocols
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: BitTorrent-like networks have attracted many Internet peers to cooperatively download media files of large sizes. Yet some selfish peers intentionally constrain their upload bandwidth, exhibiting the free-riding behavior. In response, cipherblock exchange protocols among participating peers have been proposed. The resultant cipherblocks induce big latency with respect to the availability of original blocks of media files. This paper presents a verifiable re-encryption scheme in BitTorrent-like cipherblock exchange protocols. This scheme encrypts bit strings via only bitwise combination operations. As a result, numbers of zero and one bits in the original bit string are unchanged in the resultant bit string, which allows verification checks done by the receiving peers. When re-encrypting the resultant bit string again with combination operations only, the numbers of zero and one bits are still unchanged. Such feature can be leveraged to improve the availability of cipherblocks in cipherblock exchange protocols, and would upgrade download performance, especially for newly arriving peers.

articleTitle: Analysis and comparison on new network security access technology-TNC and UAC
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Against technical defects of traditional network access control system, detail UAC and TNC two kinds of new network security access technology, and analyze and compare them.

articleTitle: A CUDA based solute interaction calculation of biomolecular simulation for GROMOS
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Molecular dynamics is an important computational tool to simulate and understand biochemical processes at atomic level. However, large system simulations with many atoms and numerous time steps require huge amount of calculation and in traditional CPU, it is time-consuming. During the past few years, graphics processing units have become an important computing platform in many scientific fields, especially in high performance computing community. In this paper,implementation of solute-solute and solute-solvent interaction calculation with NVIDIA's Tesla C1060 will be presented. Therefore, the implementation enables users of GROMOS software for biomolecular simulation to run the whole nonbonded interaction evaluation on the GPU. Our experimental results are ten to twenty times faster than the conventional sequential implementation running on the CPU core.

articleTitle: Design of a resource selection approach in grid
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Resource selection is the premise and foundation to ensure the quality of resource scheduling in grid. Accurate resource reliability risk, credibility, and real-time load filter can effectively ensure the success rate of user's job. This paper use the historical information of resources, combined with real-time load of resources, designed a new resource selection approach in grid. Simulation experiments show that this approach can effectively select the available resource set, improve the quality of resource scheduling and reduce the failure rate of grid job.

articleTitle: Edge detection for Feather and down image via BEMD and soft morphology
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Empirical Mode Decomposition (EMD) is a new concept in the field of signal processing. The technique extended to analyze two-dimensional (2D) data is known as Bidimensional EMD (BEMD). In the paper, an edge detection method for Feather and Down Image using BEMD and soft morphology methods is proposed. Firstly, the BIMF image of Feather and Down Image is decomposed by BEMD, and then the BIMF image is converted into binary image and processed using soft morphology, and the result image is edge detection of the Feather and Down Image. After detecting the edge of the Feather and Down Image using our method, the recognition rate of the Feather and Down Category is obviously raised.

articleTitle: Research on SoC test Compression
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: This paper explores SoC test Compression methods, compares the advantages and disadvantages of each method, generalizes the characteristics of every approach, expounds how each method works. The situation suitable for using a specific compression method is given. And the possible prospective is pointed out.

articleTitle: DNA-based algorithm for coloring a map of four research questions
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: There are four color on the map algorithm is based on the DNA chip technology of genetically modified organisms, by now fairly complete fluorescent color simulation software to analyze problems, and to the solution of problems by an algorithm. This article first four-color diagram into a directed graph, and the general model of DNA Algorithm undirected graph to solve the four-color map coloring the solution to the problem, explained through an example of using DNA simulation algorithm to the specific Coloring steps to prove the feasibility of the algorithm, and will be chaos and neural network algorithms to compare four coloring.

articleTitle: A method for the trust management in mobile agent system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: The security of mobile agent is an important problem for applications based on mobile agent technology. In this paper, we analyzed the security of mobile agent platform in opening distributed computing environment and proposed a trusted management method for mobile agent system. The security of mobile agent is improved by the trusted computing platform. The mobile agent trusted supporting environment is designed by using trusted software stack and trusted computing platform. Some trusted computing services, including mobile agent trusted connection, mobile agent credential and authentication, mobile agent proxy service, and integrity measurement for entities among the system are provided.

articleTitle: Community discovery algorithm based on coincidence degree
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Community structure is a structure characteristics commonly exists in all types of real network. To find out community in the network play an important role in understanding the function and behavior of the network. But the real network is changing all the time, the number of network community is changing with it, this characteristics is considered in the community discovery algorithm based on coincidence degree. The algorithm can accurately identify the network potential community by calculating and comparing the coincidence degree of network nodes and the modularity between communities.

articleTitle: The architecture design of monitoring and controlling system of central heating
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: With the development of the computer technology, the monitoring and controlling system is getting more and more important in central heating. Taking the central heating of Caofeidian for example, this paper introduces the structure, feature and function of monitoring and controlling system in central heating. The network constitute of remote monitoring controlling system of the central heating described in detail and the realization of communication. The result of operation indicates that the system is stable, and offers high regulation accuracy and is easily operated, which meets the requirements of long-term stable operation of remote monitoring.

articleTitle: Research on security of hard disk firmware
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: The hard disk drive is a commonly used storage media in computer systems. Computer users usually put a vast range of data of personal or commercial significance in the hard disks. If these data were lost or disclosed, it may lead to huge losses to individuals, businesses, and even the whole country. Hard drive firmware is the lowest, most basic software that controls the internal correct operations of the disk drive. In real life, many hard disk failures are caused by firmware problems. Therefore, it is quite important to keep the firmware safe and correct. In this paper, we demonstrate four potential threats to the hard disk firmware, and propose three safety protection approaches accordingly.

articleTitle: Three-dimension torque and drag mechanics analysis and implementation of full-hole drilling strings in extended-reach well
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Torque and drag has great effect on design and operation of drilling extended-reach well, because of its characters such as long horizontal displacement, high deviation and long open holes, Prediction and control of torque and drag is a key technique of drilling an extended reach well successfully. According to the features of field drilling practice, by analyzing the force and deformation of the drill string, the three-dimension drag and torque calculation model suited to extended reach well is established using the spatial slanting plane. Finally, the software was developed using the models and methods issued in this paper, which got a good result in field application. The results show that the model has high accuracy and the precision of this model can meet actual requirement.

articleTitle: Research on semi-supervised Chinese relation type discovery
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: In this paper, we propose a novel semi-supervised model to discover those missing relation types in labeled corpus and fulfill the aim of relation extraction automatically. We combine language information and structured information to represent candidate relation instances. First, we make use of Bootstrapping and Label Propagation algorithms to label the relation instances, whose types have existed in corpus. Second, we use unsupervised method to cluster the remaining relation instances and discover the missing relation types. Evaluation on the ACE2005 corpus shows that our proposed method can achieve ideal experimental results.

articleTitle: Chinese sentiment classification based on semantic structure of sentences
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Chinese unique expression has a significant impact on sentiment classification. According to the different semantic structures, we adopt two views, direct and indirect views. Here, direct views consist of those sentences which directly express speaker's feeling and preference towards a target object while indirect views focus on statements towards a target object for evaluation and then indirectly express speaker's Orientation. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed approach.

articleTitle: Perspective SFS 3-D shape reconstruction algorithm with hybrid reflectance model
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Shape-from-shading (SFS) is a class of three dimension shape reconstruction method from one or more images. The development of SFS method mainly depends on two factors named research on the reflectance models and computing algorithms. Most existing SFS methods are with Lambertian reflectance under orthogonal projection. This paper proposed new SFS shape reconstruction algorithm with hybrid reflectance model and perspective projection. Firstly, imaging map equation under perspective projection is formulated based on hybrid reflectance model. Then a static Hamilton-Jacobi (H-J) equation is used to describe the imaging map equation. The SFS problem turns into viscosity solution of static H-J equation. And the H-J equation is solved by fast sweeping numerical approximation method. At last, experiments are performed to illustrate the proposed method. Experimental results on the synthetic images show that the proposed method can deal with specular reflectance. Experimental results of our captured images show that the proposed method is effective when dealing with real image.

articleTitle: On the probability perception model WSN distributed k-coverage control algorithm
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Wireless sensor network coverage control commonly makes nodes dormancy and arousal by algorithm based on 0-1 apperceiving model. The algorithm doesn't reflect practical conditions. Aiming at the problem, this paper adopts the probability perception model, puts forward a new distributed k-coverage control algorithm, the node exchange information with neighbor-nodes and finds k advantage nodes on energy and ability of perception of neighbor nodes, and then sends corresponding awakening information. By the ways, every node is k-coverage controlled. It realizes working nodes decrease and working time of network increase. The simulation results have validated its effectiveness.

articleTitle: The application of mobile Agent in mobile payment
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: With the great development of computer technology and 3G communication technology, mobile payment, as an important link of the mobile electronic commerce, has obtained more attention than ever before. In the course of transaction based on the mobile payment system of J2ME, the users are unable to freely select the transaction items, which counts against the agreement from both parties involved. With the characteristics of autonomy, coordination and intelligence, the mobile Agent has laid a good foundation for its application in mobile payment. Through the study of the mobile Agent and the existing mobile payment system, this paper puts forward a mobile payment model on the basis of mobile Agent. This model takes full use of mobile Agent itself, for its features of environment sense, autonomous decisions and independent task completion, to take the place of mobile users to finish the operations in the deal, thereby greatly simplifies the whole transaction process and makes it even more intelligent, and automatic.

articleTitle: Discover web forums via user browsing behavior detection
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Web forums are important services where users can request and exchange information with others.Recently, there are more and more research works on mining knowledge from web forums due to the richness of information. In contrast, there is little work about discovering web forums. However, automatic web forum discovery is crucial for large-scale applications, e.g. a forum search engine. In this paper, we study how to discover web forums from browse log automatically. Although web forums have different layouts or styles, they always have similar implicit navigation paths leading users from their entry pages to thread pages. The implicit navigation paths make the user browsing behavior in web forums different from that in general sites. Thus we propose an efficient approach to discover web forums from browse log via detecting the specific user browsing behavior. We first build a browse map by clustering the browsed URLs, and then detect the browse behavior from the browse map. Next we adopt a few features to determine whether a site is a web forum or not. Experiment results on a large data set show that our approach is very effective and efficient.

articleTitle: Research on integrated obstacle avoidance of Robot Soccer game
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: In the Robot-Soccer, each behavior of the Robot is realized through a series of motions as people do, so a consummate motion is what people are always in pursuit of. In addition to going for goal, we also pursue fluent motions and some artistry, and the precondition to insure the fluent motions is to avoid the block. The article is mainly around as follow: how to use the molecular interaction to realize avoidance. In the Robot-Soccer, each behavior of the Robot is realized through a series of motions as people do, so a consummate motion is what people are always in pursuit of. In addition to going for goal, we also pursue fluent motions and some artistry, and the precondition to insure the fluent motions is to avoid the block. The article is mainly around as follow: how to use the molecular interaction to realize obstacle avoidance technology.

articleTitle: An improved algorithm of the support vector machine
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: According to the testing speed of the SVM depends on the number of support vector, this paper proposes the reduce vector algorithm to resolve this problem. It can reduce the calculation number of the inner product. Therefore, improve the testing speed (In particular, when a larger number of support vectors). Lastly, simulate with artificial dataset. The experiment results show the RVSVM is effective.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of dynamic incremental migration based on Xen
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: The existing migration mechanism calls for a shared storage service between the source host and the destination host, which is a necessary condition for dynamic migration. This paper proposes a dynamic incremental migration including external memory based on Xen virtual Machine, by analyzing the principles and limitations of the existing migration mechanisms. This approach makes the migration between physical hosts do not rely on shared storage any more, and widens the scope of migration technology. Performance analysis and experiment results show that the approach is feasible.

articleTitle: Research and analysis of data warehouse technologies
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: In this paper, the author will analyze technology features of data warehouse(DW)' and carry out in-depth research and analysis on its system architecture, as well as analyze on metadata, and the authors have studied the model and its advantages and disadvantages of modeling of the data warehouse.

articleTitle: Study on inconsistency of RFID tag recognition distance
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: With the rapid development of internet and other information industry, the applications of RFID become more extensive and in-depth. A great many applications call for a limitative tag recognition distance, and the tag producing and testing are strictly demanded. Presently, we are difficult to control the tag recognition distance during the production, and it is a bottleneck problem for RFID technology and products. In RFID system, the inconsistency of tag recognition distance affects many applications terribly. To solve this problem plays a significant role in not only existing application systems but also the future ones. In this paper, by discussing the causation for the inconsistency effect, a novel expiation scheme based on data analyzing and processing is proposed, and it is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: Research on optimal resource allocation of shipboard fluid system based on multi-agent
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: In consideration of the diversity of ship mission, uncertainty of the environment and the requirements for the intelligent management of marine power platform, the technology of multi-agent is introduced into the autonomous operation of shipboard fluid system and the hierarchical architecture of multi-agent intelligent control is presented. The method of optimal resource allocation with the existence of uncertainty is analyzed. Firstly, the resource allocation problem is formulated as a loosely coupled Markov decision process (MDP) and the multi-agent MDP model is established. Then the optimal resource allocation is achieved by following the optimal policy which is obtained by using genetic algorithm (GA) based on the model. Lastly, the performance of the optimal policy is examined in the emulation. The research can afford some academic guidance for raising the level of intelligence, reducing the manpower for ship operation, and increasing the mission effectiveness.

articleTitle: Avoiding the boundary effect: A sphere model for wireless multi-hop networks
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: The boundary effect emerges in random geometric graphs for modeling wireless multi-hop networks due to a given unit square in the model. That is, nodes close to the edges of the square have lower probability to connect other nodes than those nodes close to the center of the square. In this paper, the impact of the boundary effect on probability of node connecting to other nodes, and probability of network 1-connectivity is analyzed in a unit square. And then a sphere model which avoids the boundary effect is proposed to model a wireless multi-hop network. The simulation results show that the boundary effect does big harm to network connectivity when transmission range of nodes is considerable to side length of the unit square. And the sphere model is validated to be correct.

articleTitle: A new algorithm to feature detection
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: This paper describes a new feature detection algorithm, which bases on color and curvature. Since color provides valuable information in object recognition and description, a color invariant space is adopted instead of the gray space. With this method, the distinctive features extracted from images are invariant to image scale and rotation. To reduce the computational complexity and improve the quality of detection, the cascade filtering approach is employed. Details of the new feature descriptor are described, along with test results.

articleTitle: WAF-based document clustering algorithm
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: This paper proposes a novel document cluster algorithm based on Word Activation Forces (WAFs), a type of newly presented statistics.. A matrix of WAFs captures the information of terms occurrence and co-occurrence in a document, reflecting the underlying semantics that have not ever been considered from the current document representations. Its main consideration is that the same word in different documents may form disparate relation net which can be used to gain the similarities of the documents. Experimental evaluations on the dataset of the CLP2010 show that our proposed method is efficient and accurate for documents clustering.

articleTitle: The RP oriented ED-SOA framework
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: The integration of Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA) and Event-driven architecture (EDA) make it possible to build a seamlessly modern business system based on discrete units. However, the interface between them is not clearly defined. This paper focuses on the Rapid Prototype (RP) industry, and aims to realize a real-time RP monitoring system, which is able to monitor RP services and control RP processing flow. A RP oriented ED-SOA framework is provided. Based on the publish/subscribe mechanism, the devices can be controlled by the events. A prototype system is developed to demonstrate how exception message is generated and transferred from the service layer to the application layer.

articleTitle: The GPS height conversion method based on moving-surface fitting
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: How to transfer GPS heights into normal heights has become a hotspot in survey engineering. There are many GIS fitting methods adopted in GPS heights conversion. A solution is sought the points where collocated by GPS (getting h) and geometry leveling (getting H) in certain area, and we could get the values of Quasi-geoid of these points. We call these points GPS/leveling points, namely the known points. In this method, we consider the Quasi-geoid in a certain area of interpolation to be a polynomial surface or other mathematical model, then we can construct the mathematical model by the plan coordinates X, Y and N of these known points, N=f(X,Y), using this model we could calculate the N of other GPS points, namely, the points of interpolation by their plan coordinates X and Y. Then, we could get the H by the formula H=h-N. Among the many fitting function models, the moving-surface model is a comprehensive model fitting. It has an overall weighted-type fitting model of discrete features, you can use in a larger area; polynomial fitting model also has the advantage of continuity, high precision interpolation function. The basic idea is to interpolate each point as the center, using a number of interpolation points around a given point corresponding to interpolation polynomial fitting of the point values, which is a special kind of local approximation method. It can easily change the local polynomial interpolation using the number of parameters to adapt to fit flat or mountainous areas, without undermining the basic structure of the model. The paper focused on a well-applied model used in GPS height conversion, the moving-surface model has the characteristics of both the continuous model and the discrete model, the general form is presented in this paper. The example shows that the model is effective and something useful is concluded.

articleTitle: Research on the distribution characteristic for noise in observation temperature sequence sampled by wireless sensor network in Intelligent Building
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Temperature in workspace of intelligent building can be sampled frequently and instantly with wireless sensor network. With some inherent electrical characteristics of sensors and sensor node as well as the complexity thermal feature of environment in intelligent building, there are noise in temperature data sampled by wireless sensor network. To acquire temperature in workspace of intelligent building accuracy, Method for the reconstruction of noise in observation temperature data sequence is given and the workflow for the analysis of distribution characteristic of noise in observation temperature data sequence is presented Experiment results show that methods presented in this paper can provide identification basis for filters section for noise reduction with observation temperature data sequence sampled with wireless network in workspace of intelligent building.

articleTitle: A semi-supervised clustering algorithm based on local scaling graph and label propagation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: A semi-supervised clustering algorithm is proposed based on local scaling graph and label propagation. The main idea of this algorithm is that those samples locating in a local neighborhood share the same labels and the global labels changing among the graph is sufficiently smooth. The algorithm firstly introduces a local scaling graph to describe neighborhood among all the samples. Then an objective function and a constraint equation are proposed, which stand for the global smoothness of the category labels' changing and the semi-supervised information respectively. Finally, the clustering task can be expressed by a typical quadratic program, whose optimal solution can minimize the overall smoothness of the labels changing and satisfy the constraint. Experimental results of the algorithm on toy data, digit recognition, and text clustering demonstrate the feasibility and efficiency of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Log change accumulation adopted for database recovery
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: As Database technology widely used in various fields, during the process of DB application, human error, system instability, damage to storage media and so on may result in the lost of important data. It will lead to a huge disaster for individual and businesses, especially for the online businesses. So how to do DB recovery in the shortest time and in a most effective way many companies focus on. Before one Change accumulation solution that optimization of DB log in advance for IMS was put forward to speed up the process of IMS DB recovery. This paper focus on a more effective DB recovery solution research that is the optimization of change accumulation solution and compare the performance between them in IMS Database.

articleTitle: Optimal stopping framework for valuing convertible bonds with intensity to model uncertain call notice
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Empirical research shows that the call provision embedded in the convertible bonds and American call options may be delayed for different reasons. While there are several researches focused on recall provision embedded in the callable American call options under intensity-based framework, few performed detailed research on that in convertible bonds. Therefore, the main purpose of the current work is to model and study the call provision embedded in the callable convertible bonds using intensity-based approach. We formulate this as an optimal stopping problem. Under certain assumptions, we can then get a nonlinear complementarity problem that can be solved by numerical procedures. We also consider credit risk. Since there are already lots of literatures on this, we only provide a theoretical formulation under the AFV model framework.

articleTitle: Analysis of the best path on the campus of Northeast Forestry University
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Using the remote sensing images of Northeast Forestry University as base maps, the roads, buildings and other scenes on campus are vectorized after space registration, GIS spatial databases of the roads and main buildings on campus are established. Using Network Analyst extension module in GIS software to resolve network problems, people can complete the services such as finding the best path, determining the nearest public facility and creating service area, at the same time establish walking velocity-time model, determine its variation law and do the best path aid analysis.

articleTitle: Segment-based continuous stereo matching
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Stereo matching is a fundamental problem in computer vision, which aims to compute the disparity between stereo image pairs. Depth discontinuous regions are one of the most difficult regions that stereo matching algorithms have to solve, to accurately compute the disparity in those regions, in continuous methods, energy functionals which explicitly modeled the discontinuity characteristic of disparity function are usually proposed, and then those functionals are relaxed into convex. Those energy functionals usually use a simple data term which is not robust to brightness changes, and complex projection algorithms are needed to solve the relaxed convex functional. In this paper, we take the segmentation prior into the data term to make the functional more robust to brightness changes, and we propose a simple projection algorithm to give a approximate solution when solving the relaxed stereo matching energy functional. Experiments showed that our method can give a satisfied solution as other continuous methods while have an advantage that is easy to implement.

articleTitle: Image fusion of fibrous fracture surface based on Pulse Coupled Neural Network
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: A method is proposed for image fusion of fibrous fracture surface based on Pulse Coupled Neural Network. Firstly, the field depth of an image capture optical system for fibrous fracture surface is studied, and explains the cause for multi-focus image of fibrous fracture surface. Secondly, the image fusion of fibrous fracture surface based on Pulse Coupled Neural Network is introduced, which is to take definition matrix of source images obtained as input of PCNN, and then fuse the source images according the output binary image and some fuse rules. Finally, we got the image fused. The experiment proved that this method showed good fusion effect, which can get good image of fibrous fracture surface.

articleTitle: Solution and optimization of rectangle layout problem
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Put forward a method for rectangle layout problems by rectangle's feasible region in layout polygon, sort all the rectangles as their areas and take the locationing function as the basis to place the rectangle. For the layout processing, optimize the sort strategy with a random way, finally the excellent layout result is always to abtain.

articleTitle: Estimation of residual electric quantity of EV battery realized by voltage acquisition system based on 89C52RC chip
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: For EV, residual electric quantity of battery is an important basis for determination of charging and discharging of electro kinetic cell and endurable mileage of the vehicle during driving, but the current electric quantity acquisition is of defects of complicated process and poor accuracy. This work proposes estimation of residual electric quantity of EV realized by voltage requisition system based on 89C52RC chip, which mainly includes: use 89C52RC single chip chip as the core, utilize ADC0804 chip for conversion from analog signal to digital signal, and send the real-time signal acquisition of battery voltage of serial data by MAX232 chip, to realize uniting and adjustment of hardware design and software programming, and finally utilize the scheme and instrument platform in this design, to estimate the residual quantity of EV battery. It's proved by this work that the system can realize real-time and accurate acquisition of battery voltage, control of acquisition time interval, and real-time monitoring of battery status; and finally accurate estimation of residual quantity of EV battery.

articleTitle: Parametric studies in aircraft design
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: the method by which the designers select the initial ‘baseline’ design involves the use of parametric studies. This paper describes how the aircraft initial design layout is used as the focus for further parametric studies. After a brief general introduction to the methods used, an example is presented showing how different types of parametric study are used in a case study. This example may be used to guide student project work and to allow a comprehensive understanding of the design area before finalizing the aircraft configuration.

articleTitle: NBHU-based method to counter quiet DDoS attacks
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: The Quiet DDoS attack becomes one of the most severely threat to the network safety, because this kind of attack completely adopts legal TCP flow while distributing its destination IP to evade various countermeasures deployed in the network. However, the high distributed degree of the destination IP becomes one characteristics of the attack. However, we think this characteristic make partially of the attack flow not match the behavior habit of network users. Inspired by this viewpoint, we propose a novel method to counter the Quiet DDoS attack based on the NBHU (network behavior habit of users). Furthermore, we carry on simulation of our method using NS2 platform, and the results show that this method can reduce the attack performance.

articleTitle: Design and analysis of a low cost multiple-secret-key RFID security protocol
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) will become one of the most widely used devices in the near future. However, the major barrier that the RFID systems are facing presently is the issue of security. In this paper, we propose a low-cost multiple-secret-key RFID authentication protocol based on the XOR operation on large integers and multiple solution equations. The proposed protocol can achieve major security requirements in the deployment of the RFID systems with ability to prevent eavesdropping attacks, spoofing attacks, cloning attacks, and encryption algorithm explaining attacks.

articleTitle: On the performance evaluation model based on data envelopment analysis
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Performance evaluation has played the most important role in the construction of e-business, which contributes great to the nowadays world wide economy growth. It is doubtless that all the e-business concerned studies have construct a preferable theory frame work, however, how to evaluate the performance of the hereof e-business is still on its way to satisfy both the theoretical and practical demands. And further more, there are still no studies at moment which have reached its hierarchy of operation. Taking the data envelopment analysis into the theory construction, this paper focuses its attention on the proposition of an evaluation model, which aims at not only the constructions of the e-business performance from the theoretical view point but also construction of its hierarchy of operation from the practical view point.

articleTitle: Peer-to-Peer traffic anti-identification based on packet size
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: The Internet users are familiar with the Peer-to-Peer (P2P) application, which brings a lot of convenience as well as problems, especially the pressure on the network generated by the growing traffic and the security issues. In recent years, the classification and identification of P2P traffic is a more popular research area, there have been many mature and effective identification technologies. On the other hand, the anti-identification research for P2P systems is relatively slow. Through the research on the identification technology for the P2P traffic, we put forward a method to improve the anti-identification capabilities of P2P application by changing the packet size of transport layer. Experimental results show that the method makes the P2P application packets highly similar to other protocol traffics in size distribution and improves the protocol obfuscation and the anti-identification ability.

articleTitle: Moving Virtual Boundary strategy for selective sampling
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: In relevance feedback of information retrieval system, selective sampling is often used to alleviate the burden of labeling by selecting only the most informative data to label. The traditional batch labeling model neglects the data's correlation and thus degrades the performance; while the theoretical optimal one-by-one training model is not efficient enough because of the high computational complexity. In this paper, we propose a Moving Virtual Boundary (MVB) strategy for informative data selection. We adopt a novel one-by-one labeling model, using the previous labeled data as extra guidance for the selection of next, and achieve better experimental results.

articleTitle: A steganalysis algorithm based on statistic characteristics of the color images
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: This paper studies how to detect the presence of covert information in the color images.A algorithm on statistic characteristic of the color images is presented.Firstly,image's eigenvector is extracted on color change of original images and stegoimages.Then,the set of image are classified using support vector machine. Theoretically, we analyzed the methods correction; experimentally, validate the effect.

articleTitle: The design and implementation of a variable history tracker system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: During the process of debugging some large sized Java programs, history records of certain variable field are really necessary. But most of Java IDEs do not provide this function. In order to support the debugging of large-scale programs that run for a long time,it is necessary to introduce checkpoint techniques into debuggers for parallel programs. This paper puts forward a new tool to solve this problem. It is designed with AOP framework. At the same time, it supports distributed application. In practical application, it is proved to be useful.

articleTitle: Research of software dynamic trusted measurement method
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: The research of software dynamic trusted measurement is one of the hot spots in trusted computing fields. In order to improve current dynamic trusted measurement theories and methods of software. The conceptions of behavior trace are proposed to depict the dynamic characteristics of software behavior. This method uses the chains of function return addresses to derive software normal behavior models. By judging the deviation degree of software behavior, software dynamic trusted measurement is achieved.

articleTitle: GPSEM: A SDR-based LEO satellite in-orbit GPS intermediate frequency emulator
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: To develop a high performance Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite GPS receiver, a flexible and low-cost effective in-orbit GPS emulator is a prerequisite. Catering to this need, a software defined radio based LEO satellite in-orbit GPS Intermediate Frequency (IF) emulator, named GPSEM, was proposed. The GPSEM features a computer software and a USB extension hardware system. The GPSEM computer software can generate precisely combined IF signal samples of all GPS visible space vehicles at the GPS user device. The USB extension hardware system of the GPSEM is based on the most recent Nandflash mass storage technology, which can store and playback the GPS IF samples for more than one LEO orbit cycle time. A key to GPSEM is to calculate GPS space vehicles' signal transmission time with a given user position and receiver time. Toward this problem, a iterative solution based on Taylor expansion was presented. A test system was built in which the output of the IF emulator is feed into an engineering THU-1 satellite GPS receiver. The positioning results showed that the proposed IF emulator performs well, which made it an effective tool for the development of the next generation LEO satellite GPS receiver.

articleTitle: Scene analysis for fire detection
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Scene analysis is an important component of vision systems. This paper proposes a computationally efficient background modeling method based on a non-parameter statistical test. The image colors and temporal motion are integrated to capture both the temporal and spatial context of the video sequence. An updating scheme is applied for automatic maintenance of the background corners. An experiment designed for fire detection in video surveillance demonstrates that the model can solve the problems including change of illumination, short period of occlusion and small motion of background objects.

articleTitle: Runtime behavior analysis for pointer-intensive applications
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Despite continued advances in cache design and development of new hardware prefetching techniques, the system performance is limited duo to the irregularity of memory access behavior in pointer-intensive applications. Our work investigates runtime behavior of memory system and CPU CLOCK consumption for pointer-intensive applications. This paper provides experimental results on the Intel Quad multiprocessor for several pointer-intensive applications. The experimental results indicate that the memory behavior in these pointer-intensive applications expose unstable state during the process of their execution, and some pointer-chasing applications display phase change in their memory access and bus consumption. Through further analysis, we found that programming systems must overcome two fundamental limitations of modem memory hierarchies: limited transfer bandwidth and long data access latencies, to achieve high performance on pointer-intensive applications.

articleTitle: Mining method research with association rule based on improved genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: While outlining data mining with association rules and genetic algorithms, this paper proposed an association rules extraction algorithm based on modified genetic algorithm, and from struction of encoding method, fitness function and from design of genetic operators to discuss and analyze this algorithm. Finally, a simple application of data examples illustrates the effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: A blind watermarking algorithm based on block DCT for dual color images
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Firstly, this paper introduces some related concepts, principles, technology, and image pre-processing knowledge about digital watermarking. Secondly, on the basis of JPEG image compression coding and the HVS, the paper analyzes and compares some current image watermarking algorithms based on block DCT, and presents a novel dual-color image watermarking algorithm based on spread-spectrum technology and block DCT. Lastly, VC++ and Matlab7.0 are used to implement the proposed image watermarking algorithm. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm in this paper has good performances in transparency and robustness.

articleTitle: The application of Web Service technology in data mining system algorithm library
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Compared with the traditional data mining system algorithms library, the introduction of Web Service technology into data mining system algorithm library realizes the separation of data, algorithm and interface. The loose and interconnected mode greatly reduces the complexity of the development for the algorithms library in data mining system and is convenient for the dynamic management of data mining algorithm library. Besides, based on the standard and agreement irrelevant to the platform, the system design adopting Web Service is featured in platform irrelevance and language irrelevance.

articleTitle: The design and application of virtual learning community of PE theory in colleges
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: The design strategies of virtual learning community are discussed based on the analysis of present situation of college PE theory teaching. It proved necessary and probability to set up the virtual learning community for theory teaching and learning. The steps, factors and design strategies are discussed as well‥

articleTitle: Joint learning of named entity recognition and relation extraction
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Named entities are important to extract relations. Accurate relation classification helps recognize named entities. The paper presents a joint approach of named entity recognition and relation identification. The identified relation is utilized to improve named entity recognition. The method has been applied to identify the names of persons and organizations and five relations between them. The result shows that the joint approach has improved the recall and F-measure of named entities without scarifying the precision. Meanwhile, the recall and F-measure are also improved in the relation extraction.

articleTitle: Slow start algorithm based on Ad-hoc network
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Research on Vegas slow start strategy and in the Ad-hoc network congestion and the critical value problems. On the basis of this puts forward a new algorithm to solve the two problems. Environment through NS2 algorithms comparison of simulation, prove its communication performance compared with other algorithms for further improvement, but also the fairness is also good.

articleTitle: Power Constrained Gradient Decent Detection for V-BLAST system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: For Vertical Bell Laboratories Layered Space-Time(V-BLAST) system, we propose a linear multiple-input multiple-output(MIMO) detection algorithm which uses the transmit power constraints to reduce the search range in a linear space and uses the continuous gradient search method to get the optimal solution. The simulation results show that Power Constrained Gradient Decent Detection (PCGDD) detection performance is significantly better than linear detection algorithms zero forcing(ZF) and close to the minimum mean squares estimation(MMSE) detection performance. Furthermore, compared to the MMSE detection, power constrained gradient decent detection (PCGDD) omits the noise detection part and works effectively in high noise environments. So it has a lower computational complexity and a better robustness.

articleTitle: The automatic classification of the agricultural products based on the wavelet texture analysis
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: The paper puts forward a technology for the agricultural products automatic identification based on the wavelet texture analysis. The experiment chooses different levels of four apples, extracting their wavelet texture features and then classifying their features. The experiment shows that the technology has smaller computing complexity and higher stability for the product change whose products have the same kind but different classifications.

articleTitle: Research on QoS of PTN-based Power Distribution Communication Network
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Aiming at the existing shortage of the flow transmission of the Power Distribution Communication Network, packet transport network (PTN) is proposed and a PTN-based QoS scheme including differentiated services (DiffServ) and traffic engineering (TE) is introduced. QoS mechanisms are assigned for different traffic flows according to various requirements of delay, bandwidth, reliability of traffic flow in Power Distribution Communication Network to build a QoS guaranteed Power Distribution Communication Network. Simulation of delay, throughput and link-utilization with OPNET is employed based on the case study of Power Distribution Communication Network in Yun Nan, of which the result indicates that the network performance have greatly improved.

articleTitle: Research of detection system for multiple spindle fabrics viscose filament number
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: The essay introduces a high speed detection system for multiple-spindle chemical fabrics viscose filament. It utilizes the special cutter to clamp the bunch of viscose filaments, and uses the specialized shredder to produce the viscose filament slice. We design and produce the hemispherical controlled luminous LED light sources according to the slice characteristics, the light emitted by the light source passes through the filament slice, forming an image on CCD through the optical amplification. CCD transfers the captured image to the computer, segment the image of viscose filaments through digital image processing and give the result of detection after adhesion area separation and the region count. This system can detect 600 monofilaments at one time with 98% accuracy. The experiment proved that this system has advantages of high accuracy, fast detection and easy operation.

articleTitle: A new ladder Flexible MacroBlock Ordering type based H.264
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: This paper proposes a new Flexible MacroBlock Ordering type, named Ladder-FMO (LFMO), for error-resilient transmission of compressed video over packet loss networks. The proposed LFMO type outperforms most of other types supported by the H.264 standard in terms of both PSNR and encoding bit rate. In certain encoding bit rate conditions, the LFMO mode shows its better adaptability to the wireless channels transmission.

articleTitle: Study on airborne anti-submarine combat simulation bases on MAK
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Secondary development on the advanced and mature simulation platform achieves the simulation goals rapidly. Combined with the futures of the airborne anti-submarine combats, the distributed interactive simulation system based on the MAK is built. The CGF framework of airborne anti-submarine and the sensor, controller and actuator of the components are researched. The Stealth and VegaPrime are used to develop visual simulation system of anti-submarine helicopter submarine. The battlefield environment above and under water is simulated. The primary simulation case works. The results can be referred by the combat simulation system which is built on the MAK platform.

articleTitle: The flow control system for bathroom based on embedded system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: China is a country lack of water resources and the phenomenon of wasting water is very serious. Especially, the irrationality of the bathrooms' management has caused the heavy waste of water. To improve the present situation, a flow control system for bathroom based on embedded was designed in this paper. Using scientific billing methods according to flow and humanized control management, this system can achieve the goal of water-using rationalization and the high efficiency of management in bathroom. Experimental use proved that the system is reliable, economical and practical, which can be put into use.

articleTitle: Distributed automatic test system research
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: With the development of internet technology, a distributed automatic test system works in a local area network is on the date. There are very important to resolve the follow questions, how to manage the resource in the ATS, how to find and drive the instrument in the ATS. This article designs a distributed automatic test system based on the technology of distributed component object model and active directory Service.

articleTitle: Comparative study on weight function for word sense disambiguation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Context word of the ambiguous word is an important basis for word sense disambiguation (WSD). Knowledge-based WSD computes overall semantic relatedness between context words and each sense of ambiguous word. Each of context words is assigned different WSD weight based on its distance with ambiguous word. Power function and exponential function can be used to compute WSD weight. In the paper, the performances of them are compared. The experimental result shows that power function is a preferred function to compute WSD weight.

articleTitle: Research on description models of SoS combat efficient based on complex network theory
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: System-of-System counterwork is an important mode of information-based war. Under the conditions of informationization, the efficient of System-of-System combat takes representation of networked efficient based on mutual relations among the combat entities. The conception of combat System-of-System is confirmed and its logic structure is analyzed in the paper. On the basis of complex network theory, the transformation from characteristic parameters of network to System-of-System combat efficient of is realized through its network model built by the abstraction of operation units and process. It is expatiated through an example of efficient description in different command pattern of the combat System-of-System. A description and analysis method of networked efficient is put forward by the Perron Frobernius eigenvalue of the adjacency matrix. It is proved that the network efficient of combat System-of-System directly relates with the Perron Frobernius eigenvalue.

articleTitle: The design of network teaching platform based on collaborative learning
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: In this research, based on the problems of network teaching in the present stage are analyzed, learning process designing, study way's diversification as well as the study appraisal's development which take knowledge construction teaching model as the instruction have been carried on the thorough exploration. The network teaching system has been designed for supporting learning process design, independent study, cooperation study and learning process appraisal. The major functions of this system are realized using ASP and SQL Server2005.

articleTitle: A teaching experiment design of spn based on modeling video-on-demand system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Modeling real system is one of the difficult and important parts as teaching the knowledge of computer system performance evaluation. This paper takes the modeling of video-on-demand (VOD) system for example, and uses the stochastic Petri nets (SPN) introduced in Prof. Lin Chuang's book [6] to discuss the application of SPN theory in detail. Through the experiment results, we also analyze some performance metrics with various arrival rates. To teach and apply the knowledge of SPN, the SPN theory will be intuitive and easily understood if it can be applied to the modeling process of an easy instance.

articleTitle: Family particle swarm optimization for QoS multicast routing in Ad hoc
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: For the topology of Ad hoc network changes rapidly and the requirements of QoS multicast routing should be satisfied, proposed a protocol combining a new particle swarm optimization algorithm and MAODV multicast routing discovery algorithm, which divided the set of multicast trees into families. Family history optimal solution and global optimal solution would determine the optimal choice for every iteration process, until global convergence. Simulation results showed that the protocol not only met the QoS requirements of ad hoc, but also could achieve global convergence quickly and find a multicast routing tree with minimal cost and stable state.

articleTitle: The analysis on financial management system based on graph theory
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: The author construct a model based on graph theory to research financial management system. The author only studies on systematic stability under the condition that one element changes. In future the author will research multi-elements impulse. This kind of condition will be more close to real system. Therefore, based on the result of these research work, some macroeconomic policies of financial management may be regulated to make the financial management run more stably.

articleTitle: The * congruence on left inverse semigroups
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: The structure theorem of left inverse semigroups has been investigated by Yamada. In this paper, the concept of * congruence on left inverse semigroup S is introduced and the * congruence on S are described by the method of kernel and trace.

articleTitle: Application of EPON+EOC in two-way transformation of HFC network
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Now the traditional one-way transmission services of audio and video can not meet the needs of people, and so the two-way transformation of HFC network has become inevitable with the growth and development of the two-way transmission services of VOD, IPTV and so on. To begin with, the technology of HFC is introduced, and then the technology of EPON and EOC achieving two-way transformation of HFC network is illustrated in the paper. An example of project of two-way transformation of HFC network is also shown by means of the technology EPON and EOC in the paper. Finally, the summary about the technology of EPON and EOC is discussed.

articleTitle: A management policy applying to Integrated Satellite Information Network
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: With the development of space network technology, Integrated Satellite Information Network (ISIN) is playing more and more important role in national economy and national security and other fields. Integrated Satellite Information Network is the way to realize fusion of satellite communication and traditional network technology. The traditional satellite network management which uses manual configuration is with over workload, low efficiency, and lack of general adaptability. This paper uses traditional policy-based network management as its ground, combined with the characteristics of the ISIN, has designed the ISIN policy-based network management architecture, so that the policy-based network management can successfully be used in integrated satellite information network. This article use PCIM information modal as a reference, defined the XML-based policy description method.

articleTitle: Pattern recognition of Finger Motion's EMG signal based on improved BP neural networks
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: In the pattern recognition of Finger Motion's EMG signal, the Stability and Efficiency are both the problem. The paper proposes a new method of pattern recognition of EMG signal. The method uses AR model in the modern signal processing theory and numerical variance calculation to compress and make the feature extraction of the EMG. To make the classification of the eigenvalues of the EMG, these eigenvalues have been inputted to the MATLAB to build up a improved multilayer BP neural networks. For the recognition of three different kinds of finger motion's EMG signals, the experiment obtained more higher accuracy. It shows that the method is efficient.

articleTitle: Piecewise skew tent maps and piecewise cubic maps
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Output sequences of both skew tent map and cubic map were not random enough to pass NIST tests. That would influence their applications in the field of communications and information security. To overcome the shortcomings, piecewise skew tent maps and piecewise cubic maps are proposed. It is verified that the proposed maps are of larger Lyapunov exponents and their output sequences show more random features.

articleTitle: A joint estimation method of azimuth, elevation, range and polarization for near field sources based on second order statistics
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: A method is presented for the estimation of range, elevation, azimuth and polarization parameters of near-field sources based on second order statistics. The method adopts centro-symmetric cross array, and every sensor consists of orthogonal dipole-pairs with the same coordinate axis direction, and constructs eight second order statistics matrixes by receiving polarized array data, and estimates the parameters of near field according to the subspace decompositions. The method does not require any spectral peak search and easy parameter pairing only.

articleTitle: The design and implementation of Mine Mobile Information System based on iPhone
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Over the years, the tough situation of production safety in coal mine has been restricting the development of the coal industry, and is also a serious threat to the health and safety of workers in coal mine. In order to acquire the production condition, environment information and real-time monitoring of coal mine anywhere and anytime, in this paper, we design and implement a Mine Mobile Information System by integrating Internet of Things and Mobile Internet. We develop the client on iOS platform which will be a great help for coal mine enterprises to improve coal mining safety and efficiency of management.

articleTitle: Feature analysis and performance evaluation of streaming media scheduling algorithms in patching algorithm family
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: The emergence of applications such as VoD system is based on the development of streaming media. The improvement of scheduling algorithms accelerates the transform of streaming media applications from experimental phase to large-scale using. Of all the dynamic scheduling algorithms, the performance of patching algorithm is obviously superior to other dynamic scheduling algorithms. Dynamic scheduling algorithms proposed after patching algorithm are all based on it. These algorithms constitute patching algorithm family. In this paper, we first establish theoretical models to analyze the evolution of three dynamic scheduling algorithms in patching algorithm family. And then we evaluate the performance of these three dynamic scheduling algorithms. Finally, we analyze the scenario of each algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on cooperation communication based-on cross-layer for underwater wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: With the increase of requirements for the ocean information in the world, people begin to put focus on the research on underwater wireless sensor networks. The research on underwater wireless sensor networks is studied by the layer methods in the wireless sensor networks. Although this simplifies the research, the respective layer optimization is not able to guarantee the overall networks optimization. Cross layer can make up for the limitation brought by layer. Its object is to realize the balance between the performance and the design interaction in protocol layer which is not adjacent in logicalness. The cross layer among the physical, data link and networks balances the performance and decreases the transition about the control signal. It realized the maximization of saving energy and the extension of lifetime. This is very important to the underwater wireless sensor networks. The paper combines underwater communications among underwater devices, takes use of the cross layer design, considers the physical layer, modulation and forward error correct interaction, media access control and routing interaction. Based on the research on wireless sensor networks, combined with the characteristics of physical layer, the functionalities and characteristics are considered in a comprehensive way, the cross layer design is studied thoroughly, and the cross layer link transmission algorithm and cross layer link optimization are proposed which makes the scare resource effective utilization. Simulation experiments show that cooperation communication based-on cross layer is fit for underwater wireless sensor network. The algorithm increase the efficiency and throughout. They also have good stability.

articleTitle: Research on MATLAB data interaction on virtual prototype cooperative design & simulation platform
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: This paper mainly deals with data cooperative communication technique of the bottom of virtual prototype cooperative design and simulation platform. Taking MATLAB as an example studies collaborative interaction of the data. Without data source, ActiveX Data Object (ADO) technology is used to realize the connection of the database in Visual C++. And the data transmission of database and MATLAB with the method of mixed programming. The practical measurement showed that data is conveniently transmitted and easily extended between the database and the MATLAB software. This method provides a good choice for MATLAB to couple tightly in the process of virtual prototype cooperative design and simulation.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of voice mail in IP telephony based on Mediastreamer2
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Mediastreamer2 is a module of processing sound and video streams, mainly used to encode, decode, process incoming and outgoing RTP packets. This paper modifies Mediastreamer2 properly based on its principle, making iLBC the preferred codec instead of the plug-in as before, then utilizes the interface functions to design the code framework and finally implements the voice mail in IP Telephony with the guarantee of quality and efficiency. It focuses on the modification of Mediastreamer2 and the design of voice mail, and then gives a test result in the end.

articleTitle: A new online building survey system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: A new online survey system is proposed. The system composes of back-stag system and foreground system, which to survey several building parameter. In the foreground, pan and laser distance measuring instrument is combine to measure the storey edge. Several algorithms is introduced which measure the building's height, width and length. The system according to actually situation propose K-mean cluster algorithm to distinguish storey with other obstacle.

articleTitle: Manifold-based face gender recognition for video
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Automatic face gender recognition for video has become one of the hottest topics in pattern recognition and machine learning nowadays. How to better utilize the space-time information hidden in video sequences to overcome the difficulties is the key point for video-based face gender recognition. In this paper, we propose a novel manifold-based algorithm called video-based face gender using tensor subspace analysis(VG-TSA), which can not only discover more special semantic information existed in video face, but also make full use of the intrinsic nonlinear structure information to extract discriminative lower-dimensional manifold features. Finally, we compare the proposed VG-TSA with other static algorithms on UCSD/Honda and our own video databases and achieve a better performance in video-based face gender recognition.

articleTitle: Improving quality of security for CDMA using Orthogonal coding method
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: A problem of security in CDMA wireless communication has already been considered due to possibility of eavesdropping by someone during CDMA communication. As CDMA communication has wireless channels to broadcast voice or data. Therefore, we considered an orthogonal coding (OOC) method having [0, l] sequences with good cross-correlation properties can be helpful to secure communication in CDMA. Using orthogonal codes enable large number of users to transmit data efficiently and safely. In this paper, we firstly considered medium level secured transmission to make it highly secured network for communication by securing our header files combining Walsh code in the transmitted data to make it complex for intruder for decoding. For totally unsecured transmission we secured both the header file and data using Orthogonal coding method used for medium level secured communication. In this paper, we discussed CDMA orthogonal coding technique with the help of bar graphs and diagrams.

articleTitle: A hardware upgrade control strategy in weighted scale-free networks
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Real networks often undergo over-loaded traffic, which will cause congestion or even cascading failure. The limited capacity and the process rate of network nodes may cause performance degrade and serious delays. This paper analyzes the effectiveness of remitting congestion through upgrading the hardware of networks. The simulations show that congestion in a weighted scale-free network is affected by its scale-free feature and this simple way to ease the congestion effects is very significant. It shows that control only a small number of key nodes can get the similar effect of controlling all network nodes.

articleTitle: Cylindrical container heating analysis on molybdenum concentrate by microwave
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: In mine industries to warm up mine is important. However, this technique is not provides non-uniform heating within the system. Therefore, it is important to study the temperature distribution within the container by microwave heating. In this paper, a closed-form analytic solution is presented to predict the temperature distribution within a cylindrical shaped container under microwave heating. A simplified Maxwell's equation is solved for electric field distribution within the container. The heat generation by microwave is calculated from the electric field distribution within the body using Poynting theorem. Different length of the cylindrical container are studied for the effects of cylinder radius, heat transfer coefficient and incident frequency coupling between electromagnetic wave propagation and energy transfer in the system. It is found that the temperature within the body is sensitive to cylinder length. The results indicate that uniform and effective heating depend on the proper integration of geometric parameters and dielectric properties of the object. This rigorous analytic investigation will provide significant insight to understand and overcome the challenge of non-uniformity in temperature distribution in microwave heating.

articleTitle: Distributed efficient flexible cooperative MAC for mobile sensor networks
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
